paper.title: AGIDefect-4K: A Richly Annotated Dataset for AI-Generated Image Defect Detection, Localization and Explanation
paper.abstract: Generative AI can now produce highly realistic images, yet current models still exhibit subtle but critical defects that undermine their reliability. While existing AI-generated image (AGI) evaluation benchmarks have made notable progress, comprehensive AGI defect diagnosis remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce AGIDefect-4K, a richly annotated dataset of 4,000 images from 15 state-of-the-art generative models spanning both open-source and closed-source systems. AGIDefect-4K fea

summary.core_problem: 现有AIGC图像评测多停留在“好不好看/像不像”，缺少对缺陷的系统化诊断：是否有缺陷、缺陷在哪、缺陷是什么。
summary.importance: 提供面向生成模型可靠性的评测资产：把“缺陷检测+定位+解释”打包成可训练/可评测的数据集；对多模态模型的对齐与自检能力评估有直接用途。
summary.technical_approach: 提出AGIDefect-4K：来自15个生成模型的4000张图，带层级标注（缺陷存在性、像素级mask、文本解释、总体质量分）；并给出基线AGIDA，用MLLM联合做检测/定位/解释（更像诊断助手设定）。
summary.experiments: 数据规模4K、覆盖15个SOTA生成模型（开源+闭源）；摘要未给出基线模型名称与具体指标提升，重点应是多任务评测与不同缺陷类型的性能分解。
summary.authors_note: Xidian University

summary_en.core_problem: Move beyond coarse “realism/quality” scoring for AI-generated images toward structured defect diagnosis: detect defects, localize them, and explain them.
summary_en.importance: An evaluation asset for generative-model reliability, enabling training/evaluation of multimodal self-checking and defect explanation capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: AGIDefect-4K: 4,000 images from 15 generative models with hierarchical annotations (defect presence, pixel-level masks, textual explanations, overall quality score). AGIDA baseline uses MLLMs for joint detection/localization/explanation.
summary_en.experiments: 4K dataset spanning 15 SOTA generators (open + closed). The abstract does not report exact baselines/metrics; likely multi-task results and breakdown by defect taxonomy.
summary_en.authors_note: Xidian University

recommendation.zh: 把“生成缺陷”做成可监督的分层标注（含像素mask）是亮点；但4K偏小、缺陷定义主观性强，适合作为诊断评测而非训练主粮。
recommendation.en: The key value is hierarchical, mask-level supervision for generation defects; but 4K is small and defect taxonomy is subjective—use it as a diagnostic eval, not core training data.

paper.title: Institutional Books - Visual Elements: An open-source pipeline for extracting, classifying, deduplicating, and captioning visual elements from digital book collections
paper.abstract: Historical book collections contain rich visual elements - such as illustrations, photographs, engravings, and decorative art - that are frequently under-explored in large-scale digitization projects. While Optical Character Recognition (OCR) has standardized the extraction of textual content, these visual components offer a layer of nuance and context that remains largely untapped by automated text extraction workflows. This technical report introduces Institutional Books - Visual Elements, an

summary.core_problem: 如何从大规模数字化图书扫描中系统抽取“非文本视觉元素”（插图/照片/版画等），并完成分类、去重与自动caption，形成可用于多模态预训练的数据资产。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据管线+数据集释放：22.6M视觉元素来自约98万册扫描书。对VLM/统一多模态预训练的价值在于提供“书籍域”图像分布与版面风格的补充语料，以及可复用的去重与caption流水线。
summary.technical_approach: 开源端到端pipeline：从扫描页中检测视觉元素→类别标注/分类→跨书/跨页去重→生成caption（摘要未披露具体检测器/去重特征/caption模型细节）。强调与OCR文本抽取流程互补，把视觉元素作为一等数据对象管理。
summary.experiments: 释放初始数据集：从983,004册扫描卷中抽取22.6M视觉元素；摘要未给出caption质量评估、去重准确率或用于预训练/下游的实证增益。
summary.authors_note: Institutional Data Initiative, Harvard Law School Library。

summary_en.core_problem: Build an end-to-end pipeline to extract non-text visual elements from scanned book collections and produce a deduplicated, classified, captioned dataset usable for multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.importance: A data pipeline + dataset release: 22.6M visual elements from ~983k scanned volumes. Useful to VLM/unified multimodal pretraining as a complementary “book-domain” visual distribution and a reusable dedup/caption workflow.
summary_en.technical_approach: Open-source pipeline: detect visual elements on scanned pages, classify them, deduplicate across pages/volumes, and generate captions (the abstract does not specify the exact detector, dedup features, or captioning model). Positions visual elements as first-class assets alongside OCR text.
summary_en.experiments: Releases an initial dataset of 22.6M visual elements extracted from 983,004 volumes; no reported caption quality, dedup accuracy, or demonstrated pretraining gains in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional Data Initiative, Harvard Law School Library.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“可用的多模态预训练数据来源线索”：重点看去重与元素切分的工程细节；但缺少训练增益与质量评测，先按弱信号处理。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a lead for multimodal pretraining data: focus on the dedup and element extraction engineering; without quality metrics or training gains, keep it as a weak signal.

paper.title: REFRAMED: Towards Realistic Audio Description Generation for Movies
paper.abstract: Audio Description (AD) is a verbal narration of key visual content in videos, enabling access for visually impaired audiences. Unlike standard video captioning, AD is a structured editorial task: descriptions must be inserted into gaps in dialogue and must convey only what is needed to understand the narrative being told. However, existing approaches formulate AD generation in an artificial setting where both the content and timing of descriptions are pre-specified, reducing the task to clip-lev

summary.core_problem: 现有电影音频描述（AD）生成任务被简化为片段级字幕，脱离真实场景中需同时决定描述内容与插入时机的结构化编辑需求。
summary.importance: 数据与任务范式贡献：重新定义电影AD生成为联合内容+时序决策任务，并发布高质量专业标注数据集REFRAMED，覆盖206部电影的美英双语AD。
summary.technical_approach: 提出新任务设定：模型需在对话间隙自主决定描述什么、何时插入；构建REFRAMED数据集，包含专业AD、字幕、对齐剧本与场景切分，替代此前依赖噪声转录与对齐管线的方案。
summary.experiments: 数据集规模2023个视频、3302个场景、206部电影，含美英两版专业AD与字幕；论文摘要未完整报告基线模型与量化结果。
summary.authors_note: Mirella Lapata、Frank Keller为爱丁堡大学NLP资深研究者，长期从事多模态语义与文本生成研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing audio description (AD) research reduces movie AD to clip-level captioning, ignoring the real editorial requirement of jointly deciding what to describe and when to insert narration into dialogue gaps.
summary_en.importance: Task reformulation and data contribution: redefines movie AD generation as a joint content+temporal decision problem and releases REFRAMED, a high-quality professionally annotated dataset with American and British AD across 206 movies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduce a realistic AD formulation where models jointly select descriptive content and insertion timings; build REFRAMED with professional AD transcripts, subtitles, aligned scripts and scene splits, avoiding noisy transcription and alignment pipelines used in prior work.
summary_en.experiments: REFRAMED covers 2,023 videos, 3,302 scenes and 206 movies with dual-version professional AD and subtitles; full baseline metrics are not reported in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Mirella Lapata and Frank Keller are senior NLP researchers at the University of Edinburgh, working on multimodal semantics and text generation.

recommendation.zh: 任务定义与数据集工作，面向视障辅助的垂直多模态生成，与通用多模态预训练方法论关联较弱，仅作领域背景备查。
recommendation.en: A task-reformulation and dataset paper for accessibility-focused multimodal generation; weakly connected to general multimodal pretraining methodology, keep as domain background only.

paper.title: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
paper.abstract: Streaming world models predict future visual states online while maintaining physically coherent dynamics over long horizons. However, their rollouts often violate basic physical constraints. A common approach distills pretrained bidirectional DiTs into few-step causal generators. However, this paradigm suffers from two fundamental limitations: generic bidirectional teachers acquire limited physical priors from visually oriented pretraining, and the limited priors suffer further loss during bidi

summary.core_problem: 流式世界模型在长时程 rollout 中常违反物理约束，且从双向 DiT 蒸馏到因果生成器时物理先验会进一步损失。
summary.importance: 数据贡献 + 方法改进：构建 120K 真实物理交互视频数据集 PhyS-120K，并提出三阶段物理先验蒸馏框架 PhyS。
summary.technical_approach: 三阶段框架：(1) 用 PhyS-120K 对双向 DiT 做物理感知 SFT 以获取物理先验；(2) 蒸馏为少步因果生成器；(3) 用结构化物体属性与因果状态转换描述做监督。
summary.experiments: 数据集 120K 视频，覆盖刚体、软体、流体、相变；未给出具体模型规模与定量提升数字。
summary.authors_note: Cohere 团队（Liangliang Zhao 等），Cohere 在多模态与世界模型方向有持续投入。

summary_en.core_problem: Streaming world models often violate physical constraints over long rollouts, and physical priors are further lost when distilling bidirectional DiTs into causal generators.
summary_en.importance: Data contribution + method improvement: PhyS-120K dataset of 120K real-world physical-interaction videos, plus a three-stage physics-prior distillation framework PhyS.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-stage pipeline: (1) physics-aware SFT of a bidirectional DiT on PhyS-120K to acquire physical priors; (2) distillation into a few-step causal generator; (3) supervision via structured object-property and causal state-transition descriptions.
summary_en.experiments: 120K videos covering rigid-body, soft-body, fluid, and phase-transition dynamics; no explicit model size or quantitative improvement numbers provided.
summary_en.authors_note: Cohere team (Liangliang Zhao et al.); Cohere has ongoing investment in multimodal and world-model research.

recommendation.zh: 世界模型方向的物理先验蒸馏思路，对 LLM 预训练研究员主要价值在数据构建与蒸馏 recipe，看摘要和数据集描述即可。
recommendation.en: A physics-prior distillation recipe for world models; mainly useful for its data construction and distillation pipeline—skim the abstract and dataset section.

paper.title: Evaluating Communicative Belief Updates in Large Language Models via Implicature Recognition and Cancellation
paper.abstract: Human language is driven by unspoken beliefs and belief updates, making these critical to model for successful communication between large language models (LLMs) and their users. In this paper, we evaluate the ability of LLMs to recognize unspoken beliefs made through implicatures and to understand their updates through implicature cancellation: the pragmatic phenomenon whereby an utterance's implied meaning is weakened or negated. We create the first expert-annotated implicature cancellation da

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 是否真正理解会话中的隐含信念更新，尤其是 implicature recognition 与 cancellation。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测资产与误差分析：构建首个专家标注的 implicature cancellation 数据集，并把“信念更新失败”从一般语言理解里单独拎出来测。这对研究模型是否只是在套 prior、而非根据新证据更新内部状态，有一定机制启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者设计了包含隐含义、取消语和更自然场景的评测集，结合众包人类判断作为参照，系统比较 LLM 与人类在 implicature 识别和取消后的 belief update 表现；并通过控制实验区分模型是依赖先验常识，还是根据后续语句完成更新。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示主要发现是：LLM 在 belief update 上明显落后于人类，且在更自然的场景中退化更明显；控制实验表明，模型的部分成功来自对 prior beliefs 的依赖，而失败与 implicature 类型和表达形式有关。未见模型规模、样本量和具体分数细节，需看正文确认 setup 严谨度。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Mila 与 McGill University。作者包括 Verna Dankers、Marius Mosbach、Jackie Chi Kit Cheung，属于语言理解与分析取向较强的学术团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs genuinely track communicative belief updates, focusing on implicature recognition and cancellation.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is evaluative and analytical: a first expert-annotated implicature-cancellation dataset and a cleaner test of belief updating as distinct from generic language understanding. This is relevant if you care about whether models update internal state or merely lean on priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a benchmark covering implicatures, their cancellations, and more naturalistic scenarios, with crowdsourced human judgments as reference. They then compare LLMs and humans, and run controls to separate reliance on prior beliefs from actual update behavior after new utterances.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result is that LLMs lag behind humans on belief updates, especially in more natural settings. Control experiments suggest some apparent success comes from prior-belief reliance, while failures vary by implicature type and surface form. Model sizes, dataset scale, and exact metrics are not in the abstract and need verification in the paper.
summary_en.authors_note: From Mila and McGill University. Authors include Verna Dankers, Marius Mosbach, and Jackie Chi Kit Cheung, a team known for language understanding and analysis-oriented work.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“模型会不会更新信念”测得比常见 QA 干净；只看数据构造和控制实验，别把结论外推到全部推理能力。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it isolates belief updating more cleanly than standard QA; read the dataset design and controls, and do not overgeneralize the result to all reasoning.

institutions: Mila - Quebec AI Institute & McGill University

paper.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
paper.abstract: Unlike large language models (LLMs) that exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with visual reasoning, even on geometry problems that admit equivalent text, diagram, and combined diagram+text views. We show that these views often elicit different behaviors: a model may solve a problem from text but fail on the corresponding diagram, or succeed visually while failing textually. This inconsistency suggests that different views expose complementary reasoning p

summary.core_problem: 多模态推理模型在同一道几何题的不同视图（纯文本、纯图像、图文结合）上表现不一致：模型可能在一种视图下解出，在另一种视图下失败。论文研究这种跨视图不一致是否能作为自监督信号，用来提升弱视图下的推理能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发有限，但对多模态 post-training 有参考价值：它展示了一种不依赖外部教师的自蒸馏思路——用同一问题下模型自身的强视图作为教师，通过 on-policy 重打分把推理能力迁移到弱视图。这种“同一问题、不同视图互为监督”的思想，对多模态统一预训练中如何设计跨模态一致性 loss 也有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 ODA-Data：同一几何题的 text-dominant、image-dominant、combined 三种视图配对数据集。训练框架 MIRROR：对每道题，先用当前模型在三种视图下分别 rollout，选 pass 率最高的视图作为该题的教师视图；学生在受限视图（纯文本或纯图像）下采样自己的轨迹，教师视图只对学生生成的同一条轨迹做重打分（不强制学生模仿教师视角下才可见的推理路径），再结合学生视图下的 outcome-reward RL 做优化。关键设计是 on-policy distillation：学生在自己的视图下采样，教师只提供相对排序信号，避免了跨视图信息泄漏。
summary.experiments: 基座模型 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct。在 ODA-Val 上，MIRROR 相对基座 image pass@16 +14.49%、text pass@16 +5.88%；外部迁移 GeoInt pass@16 +7.59%，MathVerse mean judge score +5.22%。跨视图一致性（同一题在 image 和 text 视图下都解出的比例）从 42.5% 提升到 60.7%，净可解题目数 +8.95%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议 15–20 分钟。重点看 §1 中关于跨视图不一致的现象刻画（Table 1）、§3 的 MIRROR 训练框架图（Figure 1）以及 on-policy 重打分与标准蒸馏的区别。对预训练研究者而言，最值得带走的是“同一语义不同视图互为教师”这个自监督思路，而不是几何任务本身。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-language models show inconsistent reasoning across views of the same geometry problem: a model may solve the text-only form but fail on the diagram-only form, or vice versa. The paper asks whether this cross-view inconsistency can be exploited as a self-supervision signal to improve the weaker view.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but the idea is useful for multimodal post-training and, indirectly, for cross-modal consistency objectives in unified pretraining: the model's own stronger view on a given problem serves as a teacher for the weaker view, without relying on external teachers or curated rationales.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build ODA-Data, a paired geometry dataset with text-dominant, image-dominant, and combined views of the same problems. MIRROR evaluates the current model on all three views per problem and selects the strongest view as a problem-specific teacher. The student samples rollouts under a restricted view (text-only or image-only); the teacher only rescores the student's own trajectories (on-policy distillation), avoiding trajectories that depend on information unavailable to the student. This rescoring is combined with outcome-reward RL under the student's own view.
summary_en.experiments: Base model: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct. On ODA-Val, MIRROR improves image pass@16 by 14.49% and text pass@16 by 5.88% over the base model. Transfer: GeoInt pass@16 +7.59%, MathVerse mean judge score +5.22%. Cross-view consistency (fraction of problems solved under both image and text views) rises from 42.5% to 60.7%; net solvability gain on ODA-Data is +8.95%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, ~15–20 minutes. Focus on the cross-view inconsistency characterization in §1 (Table 1), the MIRROR framework in §3 (Figure 1), and the distinction between on-policy rescoring and standard distillation. The main takeaway for pretrain researchers is the self-supervision pattern—different views of the same semantics acting as mutual teachers—rather than the geometry task itself.

recommendation.zh: ‘同一问题多视图不一致’这个观察比方法更值钱；做 VLM 后训练的人看 ODA-Data 构造和 reward 设计即可，别期待通用结论。
recommendation.en: The cross-view inconsistency observation is worth more than the method; if you do VLM post-training, look at ODA-Data construction and reward design, but don't expect general conclusions.

paper.title: Empowering Long-form Omni-modal Understanding with Robust Audio Perception

To bridgethis gap, we present AVDC (Audio-Visual Decoupled Captions), a large-scaledataset designed to disentangle visual and auditory semantics. summary.core_problem: 全模态理解中缺乏丰富显式对齐听觉线索的大规模数据集，限制音频-视觉联合推理能力
summary.importance: 多模态数据贡献与评测贡献，构建了视听解耦的字幕数据集和CoT增强QA数据集
summary.technical_approach: 提出AVDC数据集，用现成模型自动为视频生成视觉-only、音频-only、联合视听三类解耦字幕；进一步构建AVDC-QA-CoT推理数据集；采用两阶段训练范式：先在AVDC上做全模态字幕预训练，再指令微调
summary.experiments: （摘要未给出具体模型规模和量化对比结果）

summary_en.core_problem: Omni-modal understanding is limited by the scarcity of datasets with rich, explicitly aligned auditory cues
summary_en.importance: Multimodal dataset and benchmark contribution for audio-visual understanding and reasoning
summary_en.technical_approach: AVDC dataset provides tripartite decoupled captions (visual-only, audio-only, joint audio-visual) generated via an automated pipeline using off-the-shelf models; AVDC-QA-CoT is a Chain-of-Thought augmented QA dataset; a two-stage paradigm uses caption pretraining followed by instruction tuning
summary_en.experiments: Specific model sizes and quantitative benchmark results not provided in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 视听多模态数据集工作，解耦字幕构造思路有一定参考性，看数据构建pipeline部分即可。
recommendation.en: Audio-visual multimodal dataset work; the decoupled caption construction pipeline is somewhat informative, read the data building section only.

paper.title: WildCity: A Real-World City-Scale Testbed for Rendering, Simulation, and Spatial Intelligence
paper.abstract: Humans can navigate an unfamiliar city and gradually form a coherent spatial mental map spanning tens of square kilometers. Can AI build spatial representations at a comparable scale? Although recent foundation models have advanced scene reconstruction and embodied intelligence, scaling to entire cities remains an open challenge, primarily due to the lack of city-scale data. To bridge the gap, we introduce WildCity, a real-world multimodal dataset collected by autonomous fleets traversing comple

summary.core_problem: 缺少真实城市尺度数据导致“可用于闭环仿真/空间智能”的城市级数字孪生难以扩展，如何提供数据与测试床来系统化暴露瓶颈。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是城市尺度多模态数据集+重建baseline+闭环模拟器与挑战分析；对具身/空间智能与未来多模态预训练数据形态有参考，但不是直接的LLM预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 发布WildCity：由自动驾驶车队采集的真实城市多模态轨迹数据（含动态物体、光照变化、位姿误差等真实噪声）；提供面向城市环境的重建baseline，并将重建环境转为可闭环交互的模拟器；同时对“走向可仿真的城市数字孪生”关键挑战做系统分析。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：18条轨迹，平均每条83.7km；提供城市重建baseline与仿真闭环设置。摘要未给出具体重建指标、对比SOTA或误差分解表。
summary.authors_note: Cohere（摘要标注 strong institution）

summary_en.core_problem: City-scale simulation-ready digital twins and spatial intelligence are bottlenecked by the lack of real-world city-scale data; how to provide a testbed that exposes the real failure modes.
summary_en.importance: Main contribution is a city-scale multimodal dataset plus reconstruction baselines and a closed-loop simulator, along with a challenge analysis; relevant as a data/eval asset for embodied/spatial intelligence, but not a direct LLM pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: WildCity: real-world multimodal trajectories collected by autonomous fleets, preserving in-the-wild nuisances (dynamic objects, lighting changes, imperfect poses). The paper provides an urban-tailored reconstruction baseline, converts reconstructions into a closed-loop simulator, and analyzes key challenges toward simulation-ready urban digital twins.
summary_en.experiments: Scale: 18 trajectories averaging 83.7 km each; includes reconstruction baseline and closed-loop simulation setup. The abstract does not report detailed reconstruction metrics or strong SOTA comparisons.
summary_en.authors_note: Cohere (flagged as a strong institution in the prompt)

recommendation.zh: 把它当“未来空间/具身预训练数据长什么样”的样板看：只读数据采集噪声建模与挑战分析部分，别指望直接给LLM recipe。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a template for what future spatial/embodied pretraining data may look like; skim the data nuisances + challenge analysis, not for LLM recipes.

paper.title: CanvasAgent: Enabling Complex Image Creation and Editing via Visual Tool Orchestration
paper.abstract: Complex image creation and editing often require more than a single generation or editing model. A user request may involve synthesizing images, localizing objects, segmenting regions, editing selected content, compositing intermediate assets, reading text, and enhancing the final result. Such tasks shift multimodal agents from perception-augmented reasoning to manipulation-centered visual creation, where tools must actively transform visual states rather than merely inspect them. However, exist

summary.core_problem: 复杂图像创建与编辑需要多工具协同执行，但现有多模态工具使用Agent多聚焦感知、搜索或窄域编辑，且缺乏大规模可执行图像创建轨迹的监督数据。
summary.importance: 方法创新与数据贡献；提出大规模复杂图像创建编辑多模态工具使用数据集CanvasCraft，以及可编排异构视觉工具的多模态Agent CanvasAgent。
summary.technical_approach: 构建包含140K条全标注可执行图像创建轨迹的数据集，CanvasAgent通过多轮交互学习调度合成、分割、编辑、增强等异构视觉工具，完成复杂图像创作任务。
summary.experiments: CanvasCraft含140K全标注轨迹，CanvasAgent在复杂图像创建编辑任务上性能优于现有多模态工具使用基线模型。

summary_en.core_problem: Complex image creation and editing require coordinated use of multiple tools, but existing multimodal tool-use agents focus on perception, search, or domain-specific editing and lack large-scale supervised data for executable image creation trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation and data contribution; presents CanvasCraft, a large-scale multimodal tool-use dataset for complex image creation and editing, and CanvasAgent, a multimodal agent that orchestrates heterogeneous visual tools.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a dataset with 140K fully annotated executable image creation trajectories. CanvasAgent learns to schedule heterogeneous visual tools such as synthesis, segmentation, editing, and enhancement through multi-turn interaction.
summary_en.experiments: CanvasCraft contains 140K fully annotated trajectories. CanvasAgent outperforms existing multimodal tool-use baselines on complex image creation and editing tasks.

recommendation.zh: 多模态视觉工具编排的增量工作，数据集有一定规模，对Agent工具调用训练有微弱参考，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental work on multimodal visual tool orchestration; dataset has decent scale, weak reference for agent tool-call training, read abstract only.

paper.title: AIriskEval-edu: New Dataset for Risk Assessment in AI-mediated K-12 Educational Explanations
paper.abstract: This work introduces AIriskEval-edu-db2, a new dataset designed to train and evaluate auditors based on LLMs for an explainable pedagogical risk assessment in instructional content for grades K-12. The dataset comprises 1,639 explanations from 170 curated ScienceQA questions, covering science, language arts, and social sciences. For each question, the dataset includes an explanation written by a human teacher alongside 11 explanations generated by LLM-simulated teacher profiles associated with d

summary.core_problem: 为K-12教育解释文本构建“风险评估”数据集与标注体系，用于训练/评测基于LLM的审计器（factuality、完整性、适龄性、偏见等）。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测数据集+细粒度可解释标注；对通用预训练不直接，但对安全/对齐评测与“解释质量/风险定位”任务设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 发布AIriskEval-edu-db2：基于170个ScienceQA问题收集1,639条解释（每题1条人类教师解释+11条由LLM模拟的不同风险教师画像生成的解释）；提出覆盖五维度的风险rubric，并额外提供785条带结构化可解释标注（风险定位+风险描述），标注流程为半自动+专家教师复核。
summary.experiments: 核心是数据集构建；摘要未给出系统性的模型训练结果或与现有风险评测集的定量对比（以摘要信息为准）。

summary_en.core_problem: Create a risk-assessment dataset and rubric for K-12 educational explanations to train/evaluate LLM-based auditors (factuality, completeness, appropriateness, bias, etc.).
summary_en.importance: An evaluation dataset contribution with fine-grained explainability annotations; not directly about pretraining, but useful for alignment/safety evaluation and risk localization task design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Releases AIriskEval-edu-db2: 1,639 explanations from 170 curated ScienceQA questions (1 human teacher explanation + 11 LLM-simulated teacher profiles with distinct risks per question). Provides a five-dimension risk rubric and 785 explanations with structured explainability annotations (risk localization + description) via semi-automatic labeling plus expert teacher review.
summary_en.experiments: Primarily a dataset paper; the abstract does not report extensive model training results or quantitative comparisons to prior risk-eval datasets.

recommendation.zh: 数据集本身不大，但“风险定位+解释性标注”比单一打分更可用；做对齐评测的只看rubric与标注协议即可。
recommendation.en: Small-ish dataset, but risk localization + explainability labels are more actionable than scalar scores; alignment eval folks can just read the rubric and annotation protocol.

paper.title: Safe Alone, Unsafe Together: Safeguarding Against Implicit Toxicity When Benign Images Combine
paper.abstract: Multi-image content has become an increasingly prevalent form of visual communication in social media, giving rise to a new safety issue, multi-image implicit toxicity (MIIT), where each image appears benign in isolation, but harmful semantics emerge when the images are interpreted jointly. MIIT is particularly challenging for existing commercial moderation APIs and models due to the lack of explicit risky cues in each image. This paper aims to study how to identify MIIT. We first provide a form

summary.core_problem: 研究多张单独看无害的图片组合后产生隐式有害语义的问题，并尝试让多模态模型识别这种组合式安全风险。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态安全数据与评测问题定义，而不是基座预训练方法。它提醒 VLM 安全不能只做单图或显式风险词检测，组合语义会绕过现有审核系统。
summary.technical_approach: 论文形式化定义 multi-image implicit toxicity，分析检测难点；构建覆盖七类风险的 MIIT-dataset，并用自动生成流程缓解数据稀缺；训练 MiShield，通过渐进蒸馏的 reasoning supervision，让模型输出安全判断和导致风险的实体关联解释。
summary.experiments: 实验比较 MiShield 与现有商业审核 API 和多模态模型在 MIIT-dataset 上的检测能力。摘要显示现有系统在缺少显式风险线索时表现不足，MiShield 通过关联实体分析提升了识别效果；具体模型规模、数据量和提升幅度未在给定摘要中完整披露。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学 DCST Conversational AI Group，团队长期做对话系统、LLM 对齐与安全相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies multi-image implicit toxicity, where each image is benign in isolation but harmful meaning emerges when the images are interpreted jointly.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a multimodal safety problem formulation and dataset rather than a pretraining method. It is relevant because VLM safety pipelines that only inspect single images or explicit harmful cues can miss compositional risks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize MIIT, analyze its detection challenges, build MIIT-dataset with seven representative risk categories through an automatic generation pipeline, and train MiShield with progressively distilled reasoning supervision so that it produces both safety decisions and explicit analyses of correlated risky entities.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate MiShield against commercial moderation APIs and existing multimodal models on MIIT-dataset. The abstract reports that current systems struggle under implicit multi-image hazards and that MiShield improves detection through entity-correlation reasoning; exact model sizes, dataset scale, and margins are not fully available in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Conversational AI Group, DCST, Tsinghua University, a group known for work on dialogue systems, LLM alignment, and safety.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM safety 数据问题看一眼即可；对预训练没直接动作，但组合语义风险会影响多模态数据过滤设计。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance as a VLM safety data problem; it does not change pretraining practice directly, but compositional risk matters for multimodal data filtering.

institutions: The Conversational AI (CoAI) Group, DCST, Tsinghua University

paper.title: Goku: A Million-Scale Universal Dataset and Benchmark for Instruction-Based Video Editing
paper.abstract: Existing instruction-based video editing datasets commonly focus on single-task appearance editing, failing to meet the complex creative demands of real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present Goku, a large-scale dataset featuring 2 million high-quality, instruction-aligned video editing pairs, which is the first to extend task boundaries from basic appearance editing to multi-task and structural manipulations(e.g., precise control of subject movement). To tackle the data synthesis chall

summary.core_problem: 现有指令驱动视频编辑（IVE）数据集多局限于单任务和外观层面的修改（如物体移除、属性替换），缺乏对多任务、结构形变（如相机运动、主体运动）及参考引导编辑等复杂真实场景的支持。
summary.importance: 构建了迄今为止规模最大、任务最全面的指令视频编辑数据集 Goku，首次将任务边界扩展至结构和多任务编辑，并提出了配套的基准测试和模型，为复杂视频编辑研究提供了重要的数据基础设施。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 数据集构建：设计了可扩展的自动化数据生成 pipeline，将复杂编辑指令分解为可控的子问题，并利用特定任务的专家模型处理。2. 质量控制：引入基于 Gemini2.5-Pro 的渐进式过滤系统，在指令对齐、帧间稳定性和感知真实感三个维度进行过滤，确保数据质量。3. 模型设计：提出 Goku-Edit，采用 MLLM 作为文本编码器，并引入额外的掩码预测分支增强空间定位能力，使主分支更专注于细粒度外观细节。4. 评测基准：建立 Goku-Bench，包含 1000 个测试用例和 7 个专门指标，并经过人工验证。
summary.experiments: Goku 数据集包含 200 万对高质量视频编辑数据。在 Goku-Bench 上的实验表明，Goku-Edit 模型在指令遵循方面比现有 SOTA 模型提升了高达 8%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注第 3 节关于复杂编辑指令分解和渐进式过滤系统的设计，以及第 4 节 Goku-Edit 模型中掩码预测分支的具体实现。这对于理解如何构建高质量复杂视频编辑数据和提升模型空间定位能力有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing instruction-based video editing (IVE) datasets are mostly limited to single-task and appearance-level modifications (e.g., object removal, attribute replacement), lacking support for complex real-world scenarios such as multi-task editing, structural deformations (e.g., camera movement, subject movement), and reference-guided editing.
summary_en.importance: Introduces Goku, the largest and most comprehensive IVE dataset to date, extending the task boundaries to structural and multi-task editing for the first time. It also provides a corresponding benchmark and model, serving as a crucial data infrastructure for complex video editing research.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Dataset Construction: Designs a scalable and automated data generation pipeline that decomposes complex editing instructions into controllable sub-problems, handled by task-specific expert models. 2. Quality Control: Introduces a progressive filtering system powered by Gemini2.5-Pro to filter data across instruction alignment, frame-to-frame stability, and perceptual photorealism. 3. Model Design: Proposes Goku-Edit, which uses an MLLM as the text encoder and incorporates an additional mask prediction branch to enhance spatial grounding, allowing the main branch to focus on fine-grained appearance details. 4. Benchmark: Establishes Goku-Bench with 1,000 test cases and 7 specialized metrics, all human-verified.
summary_en.experiments: The Goku dataset contains 2 million high-quality video editing pairs. Experiments on Goku-Bench show that the Goku-Edit model achieves up to an 8% improvement in instruction following compared to existing SOTA models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the design of complex editing instruction decomposition and the progressive filtering system, and Section 4 for the specific implementation of the mask prediction branch in the Goku-Edit model. These provide insights into constructing high-quality complex video editing data and improving model spatial grounding.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“视频编辑预训练数据工程手册”：重点看合成分解+渐进过滤的可靠性设计；模型结构部分先别太当真，等看清baseline与协议。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a playbook for video-editing pretraining data: focus on task decomposition + progressive filtering for reliability; be cautious about model claims until baselines/protocols are clear.

paper.title: SciIR: A Large-scale Training Dataset and Benchmark for Scientific Image Reasoning Generation
paper.abstract: While Text-to-Image (T2I) models have shown remarkable success in generating photorealistic visual content, they still struggle with the rigorous semantic alignment and logical reasoning required for scientific imagery. Inspired by Peirce's Semiotic Triad, we introduce Scientific Image Reasoning (SciIR), a comprehensive resource for training and evaluation of scientific image generation. We formalize scientific reasoning into three core dimensions: Entity Structure (Icon), Scientific Process (In

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像模型在科学图像生成中语义对齐不足、科学过程和规律表达不稳定的问题，同时缓解科学图文训练数据稀缺。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成数据资源和评测资源。SciIR-82k 提供 8 万余高质量科学图文对，SciIR-Bench 提供科学图像推理生成评测；对通用 LLM 预训练不是核心，但对多模态生成数据构造和视觉推理标注形式有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法受 Peirce 符号三元组启发，把科学图像推理拆成 Entity Structure/Icon、Scientific Process/Index、Scientific Law/Symbol 三个维度。数据集从前沿论文中构建科学图文对，并加入 Scientific Reasoning Chain-of-Thought，用显式推理链描述图像背后的视觉逻辑。
summary.experiments: 摘要明确给出 SciIR-82k 规模超过 80,000 对科学 image-text pairs，并提到 SciIR-Bench；未给出训练模型规模、baseline、自动指标、人评指标或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of generating scientific images with rigorous semantic alignment, scientific process consistency, and law-level reasoning, while also tackling the lack of scientific image-text data.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal-generation dataset and benchmark contribution. SciIR-82k provides over 80K scientific image-text pairs, and SciIR-Bench targets scientific image reasoning generation. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it is useful as a reference for structured multimodal data construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by Peirce's semiotic triad, the paper decomposes scientific image reasoning into Entity Structure/Icon, Scientific Process/Index, and Scientific Law/Symbol. It builds scientific image-text pairs from recent publications and augments them with Scientific Reasoning Chain-of-Thought annotations to expose the visual logic behind the image.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports more than 80,000 high-quality scientific image-text pairs and introduces SciIR-Bench. It does not provide model sizes, baseline details, metric values, or improvement numbers in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据构造和评测维度；Sci-RCoT 是否真提升生成模型，得看消融而不是概念框架。
recommendation.en: Skim the data schema and evaluation axes; whether Sci-RCoT actually helps needs ablations, not the semiotic framing.

paper.title: Ill-Posed by Design: Probing Evidence Use in VLMs
paper.abstract: Counterfactual analysis is widely used to study evidence use in vision-language models, but its diagnostic value is limited on well-posed tasks: when several cues independently support the same answer, removing one may not change the prediction. We propose monocular metric object-size estimation as an ill-posed diagnostic setting for evidence selection: because physical size cannot be determined from a single uncalibrated image, models must rely on imperfect cues category priors, target appearan

summary.core_problem: 这项工作把单目物体真实尺寸估计设计成一个 VLM 证据使用诊断任务，用来回答模型在视觉问答中到底依赖类别先验、目标像素、上下文、显著尺寸还是场景几何。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在评测方法，而不是模型训练。常规 VQA 或识别任务往往是良定问题，多个线索都能支持同一答案，遮掉一个线索后预测不变并不能说明模型没有用它。单目真实尺寸估计是欠定问题，单张未标定图像无法唯一确定物理尺度，因此模型必须在不完美证据之间做选择。这个设置更容易暴露 VLM 的视觉 grounding 是否真的进入了数值估计过程。结果显示，大模型规模并不自动带来几何线索使用能力，开源 VLM 在 in-the-wild split 上甚至落后于无图像输入的前沿文本 LLM，说明相当一部分性能来自类别和语言先验。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是构建 Metric VQA，并围绕六类证据通道做反事实干预。任务形式是给定一张 RGB 图像和自然语言尺寸问题，例如“这个微波炉多高”，要求模型输出厘米单位的单个浮点数。数据包含两个 split：Objectron 派生的 10,482 个查询，来自 3,494 帧、9 个日常类别、27 个 category-axis 查询模板，尺寸标签来自 3D bounding box；in-the-wild split 包含 70 张真实场景照片、331 个胶尺测量查询，覆盖杂乱背景、多物体、遮挡和复杂视角。评测时用确定性 regex 抽取第一个数值，无法解析记为 parse failure，并对大于 10^4 cm 的预测做截断以避免异常数值主导 MAE。反事实干预覆盖类别先验、目标像素、目标身份、局部上下文、图像中 apparent size、全局场景几何。这个设计的重点不是提高尺寸估计精度，而是通过干预前后预测漂移判断哪些证据是 load-bearing。工作还分析了监督 LoRA 微调，观察模型是否能通过任务训练获得新的几何使用能力。
summary.experiments: 实验评估了 12 个开源 VLM，参数规模从 3B 到 397B，并加入一个无图像输入的前沿文本 LLM 和人类参考。关键结论有三点。第一，在更接近真实场景的 in-the-wild split 上，即使是 Qwen3-VL-235B、InternVL3.5-241B、Qwen3.5-397B 这类大规模开源 VLM，也落后于只看文本问题的前沿 LLM。这说明模型在尺寸估计中大量依赖物体类别的常识分布。第二，干预签名呈现清晰分层：目标身份最稳定地影响预测；目标像素和局部上下文只被部分模型使用；apparent size 会改变预测，但方向不稳定，说明模型可能感知到图像尺度变化，却没有学到可靠的物理尺度映射；全局场景几何基本没有被有效使用。第三，LoRA 微调能提升任务表现，但提升主要来自放大基座模型已有的线索通道，例如目标身份、局部上下文或语言先验访问，而不是学会利用场景几何。这个结果对 VLM post-train 很有提示：任务分数上升不等于视觉几何机制改善。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Benchmark and Setup，确认 Metric VQA 的标签来源、数值解析和两个 split 的差异；再看 counterfactual intervention 设计，尤其是六个证据通道如何被隔离。实验部分应重点看各模型在 Objectron 与 in-the-wild 上的差异、文本 LLM baseline 的位置、以及干预签名图。LoRA 分析值得单独看，因为它区分了“任务可学”和“学到新视觉机制”这两个容易混淆的问题。对预训练研究员来说，最有用的是这个评测范式：选择欠定任务，让模型无法只靠单一充分证据完成任务，从而更清楚地暴露训练数据和对齐阶段形成的先验。

summary_en.core_problem: The work uses monocular metric object-size estimation as a diagnostic setting for probing which evidence channels VLMs actually rely on: category priors, object pixels, object identity, local context, apparent image size, or global scene geometry.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in evaluation design rather than pretraining methodology. Standard VQA and recognition tasks are often well-posed: several cues can independently justify the same answer, so removing one cue may not change the prediction. Metric size estimation from a single uncalibrated image is underdetermined, forcing the model to fall back on imperfect cues. This makes counterfactual interventions more informative. The results are relevant for multimodal pretraining because they show that larger open-weight VLMs do not necessarily acquire usable geometric evidence selection, and that strong numeric answers can come from language and category priors rather than visual grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build Metric VQA, where each example contains an RGB image, a natural-language dimension query, and a ground-truth physical measurement in centimeters. The benchmark has 10,813 queries: 10,482 Objectron-derived queries from 3,494 frames across 9 everyday categories, using 3D bounding-box dimensions as labels, and 331 in-the-wild queries from 70 cluttered scenes with tape-measured ground truth. Model outputs are parsed with a deterministic regex that extracts the first numeric value; unparseable answers are counted as parse failures, and predictions above 10^4 cm are clipped for aggregate MAE. The key methodological contribution is a set of counterfactual interventions over six evidence channels: category priors, target pixels, target identity, local context, apparent image size, and global scene geometry. The paper also studies supervised LoRA fine-tuning to test whether task training makes the models learn new geometric cues or merely strengthens existing ones.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 12 open-weight VLMs ranging from 3B to 397B parameters, plus a frontier text-only LLM without image access and a human reference. The strongest qualitative result is that on the in-the-wild split, even large open VLMs such as Qwen3-VL-235B, InternVL3.5-241B, and Qwen3.5-397B trail the text-only LLM. The intervention analysis shows a stratified pattern: target identity is consistently load-bearing; target pixels and local context are used only by some models; apparent image size shifts predictions but not in a directionally reliable way; global scene geometry is mostly unused. LoRA fine-tuning improves the task, but the gains come from enhancing evidence channels that the base model already partially uses, rather than from learning robust scene-geometry reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the benchmark construction and evaluation protocol first, especially the difference between Objectron and the in-the-wild split. Then focus on the counterfactual intervention definitions and the plots showing intervention signatures. The LoRA section is useful because it separates task learnability from the acquisition of new visual mechanisms. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main transferable idea is to use ill-posed tasks as diagnostic probes: they reduce cue redundancy and make evidence use easier to observe.

recommendation.zh: 把“证据使用”评测从 well-posed 拉到 ill-posed，反事实 probing 才有区分度；只看任务设计+证据通道分解，别把绝对分数当能力结论。
recommendation.en: Making the probe ill-posed is the real contribution—counterfactuals finally become discriminative; read the task design + evidence-channel decomposition, but don’t over-interpret raw scores as capability.

paper.title: JAMER: Project-Level Code Framework Dataset and Benchmark on Professional Game Engines
paper.abstract: Current AI-driven game development has made substantial progress in asset generation, gameplay design, and web-based game coding, yet project-level code engineering on professional game engines remains largely unexplored due to the absence of large-scale datasets and deterministic evaluation methods. We present JamSet and JamBench, the first project-level game code framework dataset and benchmark built on a professional game engine. Our key insight is that Game Jam competitions, community events

summary.core_problem: 解决专业游戏引擎场景下项目级代码生成与工程化评测缺少大规模数据和可重复验证基准的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据集加 benchmark。它不直接推进预训练方法，但对代码模型从函数级走向项目级、可执行验证的评测设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者利用 Game Jam 开源项目构建 JamSet 与 JamBench，依托 Godot 的文本格式和 headless 执行能力，设计从文件完整性到运行时行为采集的确定性验证流水线。核心创新在于把仓库级代码任务变成可自动判定的执行型 benchmark。
summary.experiments: 从 24 万多个仓库中筛出 8,133 个验证通过的项目，其中 300 个人工核验项目组成 JamBench，其余构成 JamSet。摘要未给出详细模型对比数字，但可以判断评测重点是主题驱动生成、项目级修改与运行时验证，而不是单文件补全。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南开大学、Shanghai Innovation Institute、Alaya Studio 等。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of large-scale data and deterministic evaluation for project-level code generation on professional game engines.
summary_en.importance: This is a dataset-and-benchmark contribution. It does not directly advance pretraining methodology, but it is useful for evaluating code models beyond function-level tasks toward executable project-level engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds JamSet and JamBench from open-source Game Jam projects, leveraging Godot's text-based format and headless execution mode to create a deterministic verification pipeline from file integrity checks to runtime behavior collection. The key idea is to turn repository-scale code tasks into executable, automatically verifiable benchmarks.
summary_en.experiments: The authors distill 8,133 verified projects from over 240,000 repositories, with 300 manually verified projects forming JamBench and the rest forming JamSet. The abstract does not provide detailed model comparisons, but the benchmark clearly targets theme-driven generation, project-level editing, and runtime validation rather than single-file completion.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Nankai University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, Alaya Studio, and collaborators.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做代码预训练或 repo-level agent，这个 benchmark 值得建档；否则只看数据构建和 deterministic verification 设计，别把它当方法论文。
recommendation.en: Worth archiving if you work on code pretraining or repo-level agents; otherwise just read the dataset construction and deterministic verification design, not as a methods paper.

paper.title: OmniVideo-100K: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Reasoning through Structured Scripts and Evidence Chains
paper.abstract: Current automated pipelines for audio-visual Question Answering (QA) generally adopt a ``video-caption-QA'' paradigm. However, these methods typically segment videos into short clips and generate separate descriptions for audio and visual modalities. This decoupled processing severs inherent associations between sounds and their visual sources, while independent clip processing often causes inconsistent descriptions of the same entity across segments. Furthermore, coupling long-text comprehensio

summary.core_problem: 解决现有音视频问答数据自动构建流程中，音画对齐被切断、跨片段实体不一致、问题缺乏长时程推理链的问题。
summary.importance: 这是评测/数据资产工作，贡献在于构建音视频推理数据集与自动化数据引擎。对做多模态预训练的人，价值主要在于看数据构造范式：如何把长视频转成结构化 script 和 evidence chain，提升训练或评测信号质量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出自动数据引擎，核心有两点：一是 Entity-Anchored Video Scripting，把视频转成包含全局摘要、主实体列表、分段音视频描述的结构化脚本，用实体列表维持跨片段一致性；二是基于 evidence chain 的 QA 合成，把长时程、多跳、跨模态关联显式写入问题构造流程，避免单步 caption→QA 的局部化偏差。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明产出 OmniVideo-100K 数据集，用于音视频推理；但未给出数据规模细节之外的模型、baseline 和提升幅度。若正文包含不同数据引擎对下游模型性能的对照，这部分才值得看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses failures in automated audio-visual QA data construction, where audio-visual grounding is broken, entities become inconsistent across clips, and generated questions lack long-horizon reasoning chains.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation/data-asset contribution. For multimodal pretraining researchers, the main value is the data-construction recipe: converting long videos into structured scripts and evidence chains to improve supervision quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes an automated data engine with two main components. First, Entity-Anchored Video Scripting converts a video into a structured script containing a global summary, a main-entity list, and segment-level audio-visual descriptions, using the entity list as a global prior for consistency. Second, evidence-chain-based QA synthesis explicitly builds long-range, multi-hop, cross-modal reasoning into the generated questions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract introduces the OmniVideo-100K dataset for audio-visual reasoning, but does not provide model sizes, baselines, or quantitative gains. It becomes worth reading only if the main paper includes clean ablations on how the data engine changes model behavior.

recommendation.zh: 作为多模态数据工程样例可以记一下，但更像评测资产而非方法突破；只看数据构造流程和 evidence chain 设计，不必深读实验。
recommendation.en: Useful as a multimodal data-engineering reference, but this is more an evaluation asset than a method shift; read the data pipeline and evidence-chain design, not the full experiments.

paper.title: 4DP-QA: Scalable QA for 4D Perception in Vision Language Models
paper.abstract: Despite recent advances, Vision Language Models (VLMs) still struggle to grasp the dynamics of the world. We note that the ability to reason about a 4D scene, challenging in itself, is further complicated by two factors. First, VLMs observe motion indirectly via its projection onto 2D images. Second, existing datasets fail to disentangle object and camera motion. To address these challenges, we present a QA generation pipeline that focuses on motion-related scene understanding. We take particula

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 VLM 难以理解 4D 场景动态，尤其难以区分相机运动与物体真实运动的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是数据与评测资产，加上一套面向运动理解的 QA 生成流程。它对原生多模态预训练有间接启发，尤其是视频/时序 VLM 需要什么监督信号，但离 LLM 基座预训练仍有一层距离。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 4D Perception QA 生成管线，核心是同时使用传统 tracking 和新定义的 True-Motion Tracking，把物体运动放到固定参考系中描述，以减少相机运动和物体运动的纠缠；基于此生成 400K 训练样本和 2.2K benchmark。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 400K 训练样本和 2.2K benchmark。实验方式是用该数据训练现有模型，并在外部 benchmark 上验证性能提升。摘要未给出具体模型规模、基线名称和提升幅度，因此目前更像数据有效性的初步证明，而不是范式级方法结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Yale University；摘要中未出现可明确识别的业界标志性作者。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the difficulty VLMs have in understanding 4D scene dynamics, especially disentangling camera motion from true object motion.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a data-generation and evaluation asset, plus a motion-focused QA pipeline. It is indirectly useful for native multimodal pretraining, especially for what supervision video/time-aware VLMs may need, but it is still one step removed from core LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a 4D Perception QA generation pipeline. Its key idea is to combine standard tracking with a new True-Motion Tracking formulation that describes motion in a fixed reference frame, reducing entanglement between camera and object motion. This is used to build a 400K-sample training set and a 2.2K benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 400K training samples and a 2.2K benchmark. Existing models are trained on the new data and evaluated on an external benchmark, showing gains. The abstract does not provide model sizes, baselines, or exact margins, so the evidence currently reads as a useful data signal rather than a paradigm shift.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Yale University; no clearly identifiable high-profile industry author can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做视频/时序 VLM，值得看它怎样把 camera motion 从 supervision 里剥开；否则读数据构造部分就够，方法本身不深。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the supervision design that disentangles camera motion from object motion in video VLMs; otherwise, the data-construction section is enough.

paper.title: Humans' ALMANAC: A Human Collaboration Dataset of Action-Level Mental Model Annotations for Agent Collaboration
paper.abstract: Recent advances in LLM agents have enabled complex cognitive capabilities, such as multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool use, that increasingly position these agents as human collaborators. Effective collaboration, however, requires collaborators to continuously maintain and align mental models of their own reasoning,partners' intentions, and shared goals during the collaborative process. Today's agents rarely develop such capabilities since they are primarily optimized for task completion, a

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 缺少过程级协作数据的问题，尤其是缺少带 action-level mental model 标注的人类协作语料，导致 agent 只会完成任务而不会与人协作。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是数据集与标注框架。它对 agent 评测和训练有一定价值，但离基座预训练较远；更适合关注 AI delegation、协作式 agent、过程监督的人。
summary.technical_approach: 作者基于经典社会科学任务 Map Task 构建 ALMANAC 数据集，对 2,987 个协作动作进行理论驱动的 mental model 标注，覆盖参与者对自身状态、对方意图和共享目标的理解，从而把“协作中的心智对齐”显式化为可训练/可评测信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调的是数据集构建而非模型突破，未给出大规模模型训练结果。实验价值主要在于提供 action-level mental model annotation，可用于分析 agent 在协作过程中的状态追踪与对齐能力。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Northeastern University、University of Notre Dame、University of Waterloo、Carnegie Mellon University 等，偏 HCI、可视化与人机协作研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of process-level collaboration data for LLM agents, especially human collaboration corpora with action-level mental-model annotations.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a dataset and annotation framework. It is useful for agent evaluation and training, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on the classic Map Task from social science, ALMANAC annotates 2,987 collaboration actions with theory-informed mental-model labels, covering self-state, partner intention, and shared-goal understanding. This turns mental-model alignment during collaboration into an explicit signal for training or evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes dataset construction rather than model advances, and does not report large-scale model training. The value lies in providing action-level mental-model annotations for analyzing whether agents track and align collaborative state over time.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Northeastern University, University of Notre Dame, University of Waterloo, and Carnegie Mellon University, with a profile closer to HCI, visualization, and human-AI collaboration.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 AI delegation 或过程监督，可以记住这个数据集；否则和基座预训练距离较远，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Worth bookmarking if you work on AI delegation or process supervision; otherwise it is too far from core pretraining to justify a full read.

paper.title: AnyMo: Scaling Any-Modality Conditional Motion Generation with Masked Modeling
paper.abstract: Conditional human motion generation remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision and robotics. Despite significant progress, current methods are often constrained by fixed modality configurations and task-specific architectures, leaving cross-modal interactions and the scaling laws of multimodal-conditioned synthesis largely underexplored. A key bottleneck is the scarcity of large-scale modality-aligned motion data, limiting generalization across diverse control signals. In this work, we i

summary.core_problem: 如何在“任意条件模态组合”（文本/语音/音乐/轨迹等）下进行可扩展的人体动作生成，并解决大规模模态对齐动作数据稀缺的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是大规模多模态对齐动作数据集 + 统一的离散 tokenizer（Residual FSQ）+ masked modeling 生成范式；对“把新模态离散化并接入统一 Transformer 目标”的预训练研究有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 OmniHuMo 数据集（5000+ 小时、320 万序列，多模态精确对齐）；提出 AnyMo：用 Residual FSQ 做 motion tokenizer，把动作序列离散化后，用可扩展 masked modeling Transformer 做条件生成，支持任意模态组合条件输入。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露模型规模、训练 token 量、与哪些 SOTA motion generation baseline 对比及具体提升；只声称在广泛条件组合下达到高质量合成。

summary_en.core_problem: How to scale human motion generation conditioned on arbitrary combinations of modalities (text/speech/music/trajectory) under the bottleneck of scarce modality-aligned motion data.
summary_en.importance: Main value is a large aligned dataset plus a unified discrete tokenizer (Residual FSQ) and masked-modeling generation; indirectly relevant to foundation pretraining via “tokenize a new modality + train with a Transformer objective”.
summary_en.technical_approach: Releases OmniHuMo (5,000+ hours, 3.2M sequences with aligned multimodal annotations). Proposes AnyMo: discretize motion with a Residual FSQ tokenizer and train a scalable masked-modeling Transformer for conditional generation under arbitrary modality combinations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits model size, training compute/tokens, concrete baselines, and numeric gains; it only claims strong results across many conditioning setups.

recommendation.zh: 只看两点：Residual FSQ 的 motion 离散化设计和“任意条件组合”的 masked objective；其余更像动作生成/数据集工作，别按 LLM 预训练期待。
recommendation.en: Read it for the Residual-FSQ motion tokenization and the “any-modality conditioning” masked objective; beyond that it’s mostly a motion dataset/generation paper, not a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Scaling, Benchmarking, and Reasoning of Vision-Language Agents for Mobile GUI Navigation
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown rapid progress in mobile GUI navigation. This paper presents a systematic study of data scaling, benchmarking, and reasoning for VLM-based agents in this domain. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we introduce HyperTrack, a large-scale dataset with over 16000 real-world tasks across more than 650 Chinese mobile applications, along with GUIEvalKit, an open-source toolkit for unified benchmarking of VLMs on offline GUI navigation tasks. Using HyperTrack, we

summary.core_problem: 现有移动端GUI导航的视觉语言智能体缺乏大规模中文场景数据集、统一评测工具，且训练数据规模对监督微调、强化微调的影响，以及推理能力对任务表现的作用均缺乏系统性研究。
summary.importance: 提供了中文移动端GUI领域的大规模评测资产和数据缩放规律结论，对多模态智能体的后训练数据配比、训练范式选择有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1）构建HyperTrack数据集，包含674款中文安卓应用的16080条真实任务轨迹，覆盖分层UI文档、动作 bounding box、屏幕描述等多维度标注，支持域内、未见应用、未见设备等多维度泛化评测；2）开发开源统一评测工具包GUIEvalKit；3）基于数据集系统性对比监督微调（SFT）和DAPO增强的GRPO强化微调范式的缩放规律，评测主流开源VLM的GUI导航表现。
summary.experiments: 强化微调在所有数据规模下均优于监督微调，尤其是域外泛化场景，体现了数据规模与RL的协同效应；交互历史完整性、模型推理能力对GUI任务成功率有显著正向影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读数据集统计与对比表格，数据缩放实验的SFT与RL性能对比曲线，预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 武汉大学、小米，通讯作者高鹏志（小米）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing vision-language agents for mobile GUI navigation lack large-scale Chinese scenario datasets and unified evaluation tools. There is also no systematic research on the impact of training data scale on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement fine-tuning, as well as the effect of reasoning ability on task performance.
summary_en.importance: It provides large-scale evaluation assets and data scaling law conclusions for the Chinese mobile GUI domain, and has reference value for post-training data ratio selection and training paradigm selection for multimodal agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Construct the HyperTrack dataset, which contains 16080 real task trajectories from 674 Chinese Android apps, covering multi-dimensional annotations such as hierarchical UI documents, action bounding boxes, and screen descriptions, supporting multi-dimensional generalization evaluation including in-domain, unseen app, and unseen device settings. 2) Develop the open-source unified evaluation toolkit GUIEvalKit. 3) Systematically compare the scaling laws of SFT and DAPO-augmented GRPO reinforcement fine-tuning paradigms based on the dataset, and evaluate the GUI navigation performance of mainstream open-source VLMs.
summary_en.experiments: Reinforcement fine-tuning outperforms supervised fine-tuning across all data scales, especially in out-of-domain generalization scenarios, demonstrating the synergy between data scale and RL. Completeness of interaction history and model reasoning ability have significant positive effects on GUI task success rate.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the dataset statistics and comparison tables, and the SFT vs RL performance scaling curves in data scaling experiments. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Wuhan University, Xiaomi; corresponding author: Pengzhi Gao (Xiaomi)

recommendation.zh: 提供了一个大规模的 GUI Agent 数据集和评测基准，其关于 RL 在 OOD 泛化上优于 SFT 的结论对 Agent 训练有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Provides a large-scale GUI agent dataset and benchmark; the conclusion that RL outperforms SFT in OOD generalization is valuable for agent training.

paper.title: GEM: Generative Supervision Helps Embodied Intelligence
paper.abstract: Embodied Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance and generalization in robotics, particularly within Vision-Language-Action frameworks. However, a significant gap remains between the high-level semantic focus of standard text-guided pre-training paradigms and the low-level spatial and physical knowledge critical for execution in embodied environments. In this paper, we introduce GEM, a Generative-supervised Embodied vision-language Model designed to bridge this div

summary.core_problem: 解决具身 VLM 预训练偏重高层语义、缺少低层空间与物理知识，导致执行阶段感知-动作脱节的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个多模态预训练配方改进工作：把深度图生成作为联合监督信号引入具身 VLM 预训练，并配套构建 4M 规模数据集，目标是提升机器人场景中的空间理解与操作能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上提出 GEM，在标准视觉-语言建模之外加入 depth map generation 生成式监督，让模型在预训练阶段同时学习语义对齐与几何结构。论文还发布 GEM-4M，混合 grounding、reasoning、planning 等数据，并配有高质量深度监督，用于支撑这一联合训练范式。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称在 embodied intelligence / Vision-Language-Action 场景上带来显著提升，尤其改善语义理解和物理操作能力；但从给定信息看，尚无法确认模型规模、训练 token/样本量、具体 baseline、提升幅度和是否在主流基准上形成稳定领先。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the mismatch between semantically oriented VLM pretraining and the low-level spatial/physical knowledge required for embodied execution.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal pretraining recipe change: it adds depth-map generation as an auxiliary generative objective and releases a 4M-scale dataset to improve spatial grounding and action-relevant understanding in embodied settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: GEM jointly trains a VLM with its main objective plus a depth generation task, so the model learns semantic alignment together with geometric structure. The accompanying GEM-4M dataset mixes grounding, reasoning, and planning data with depth supervision to support this setup.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports substantial gains on embodied intelligence and VLA-style tasks, especially in semantic understanding and physical operation. However, from the provided information, model size, training scale, baselines, exact margins, and the cleanliness of the evaluation setup are still unclear.

recommendation.zh: 对纯文本 pretrain 启发有限，但若你在看 native multimodal 或机器人预训练，先查数据构成和 auxiliary loss 权重；很多这类收益最后都来自数据而不是目标本身。
recommendation.en: Limited value for text-only pretraining, but if you care about native multimodal/robotics pretraining, inspect the data mix and auxiliary-loss weighting first; gains in this line often come more from data than from the objective.

paper.title: Merge-Bench: Resolve Merge Conflicts with Large Language Models
paper.abstract: This paper applies machine learning to the difficult and important task of version control merging. (1) We constructed a dataset, Merge-Bench, of 7938 real-world merge conflict hunks from 1439 GitHub repositories. The ground truth is the merge resolution that developers committed to the repository. Our dataset construction methodology is scalable to arbitrary amounts of data since no manual labeling is required. (2) We trained a model, LLMergeJ, to resolve merge conflicts in Java programs. Our a

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个可规模化、尽量抗 reward hacking 的真实世界 merge conflict 基准，并用在线 RL（GRPO）训练 LLM 自动解决代码合并冲突，同时给出可扩展的评测范式。
summary.importance:
对“预训练方法/数据/优化”本身的直接增量有限，因为核心贡献更偏向软件工程任务数据集与 RL 训练实例。但它提供了两个对基座研究仍有参考的点：
- 互联网规模、零人工标注的数据构造：从 VCS 历史自动抽取“问题-答案”（冲突块→开发者提交的解决方案），这类监督信号获取方式可迁移到其他代码编辑/修复类 pretrain 或 mid-train 任务。
- 训练信号设计与 reward hacking 规避：他们明确回避“跑测试套件当 reward”的常见陷阱，提出 test-free 的评测/训练范式与输出归一化流程，这对做 RL-on-code 的人是实用经验。
summary.technical_approach:
数据：Merge-Bench，7938 个真实 merge conflict hunks，来自 1439 个 GitHub 仓库；每个样本包含 diff3 形式的 left/base/right 以及前后各最多 20 行上下文，ground truth 是开发者最终提交的 resolution。构造流程通过回放历史 merge 来自动收集冲突与解决方案，不需要人工标注；并通过控制每仓库采样量提高多样性。
训练：LLMergeJ（14B）用 GRPO 做在线 RL 来生成冲突解决结果。论文把它定位为“human-filter-free SWE-RL”：不做人工筛选/手工规则修补，依赖可规模化的自动评测信号。
评测：提出 test-free 的评测范式，并对不同 merge 工具输出做 normalization，避免格式差异影响匹配；同时做跨语言的商业模型评测（11 种语言）。
summary.experiments: 在 Java 冲突上，LLMergeJ（14B）达到 49% exact match、59% source code match（按论文口径应是归一化后的文本/代码匹配）。论文还声称其表现优于 3 个商业 LLM（具体型号与设置需要在实验章节核对）。此外给出 6 个商业模型在 11 种语言上的对比评测，用于刻画任务难度与泛化差异。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 40–60 分钟）：
- 先看数据构建与过滤细节：如何回放 merge、如何抽取 hunk、如何控制泄漏与多样性，这是最可复用的部分。
- 再看 test-free 评测与 normalization：它决定了 RL reward/离线指标是否可信，也是论文声称“抗 reward hacking”的关键。
- 最后看 GRPO 训练设置与失败案例分析（如果有）：重点关注 reward 设计、采样策略、以及模型输出常见错误类型。
如果你的关注点是基座预训练 recipe，这篇更适合作为“代码领域可规模化监督信号与 RL 评测设计”的参考，而不是直接的 pretrain 方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: Build a scalable, realistic benchmark for version-control merge conflicts and train an LLM (via online RL with GRPO) to resolve conflicts, using an evaluation paradigm designed to avoid test-suite reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: This is more SWE/RL-for-code than core pretraining methodology, but it offers two reusable ideas for foundation-model training pipelines: (1) scalable supervision mined from VCS history (conflict hunks paired with developer-committed resolutions) without manual labeling, and (2) explicit attention to reward design and reward-hacking avoidance by not relying on running project tests as the primary signal.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Dataset: Merge-Bench with 7,938 real-world conflict hunks from 1,439 GitHub repos. Each example is represented as a diff3-style left/base/right conflict plus up to 20 lines of surrounding context; the label is the resolution text developers actually committed. Collection is automated by replaying merges across branches and sampling to increase diversity.
Training: LLMergeJ (14B) trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) in an online RL setup, positioned as a “human-filter-free SWE-RL” task.
Evaluation: a test-free evaluation paradigm plus output normalization to compare merge outputs robustly; additional cross-language evaluation of commercial LLMs across 11 languages.
summary_en.experiments: On Java conflicts, LLMergeJ (14B) reports 49% exact match and 59% source code match (per the paper’s matching/normalization protocol). The paper also reports LLMergeJ outperforming three commercial LLMs on Java (exact model identities and prompting need to be checked in the experiments section). It further benchmarks six commercial models across 11 programming languages.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (40–60 minutes):
- Focus on dataset construction and filtering: merge replay, hunk extraction, diversity controls, and leakage discussion.
- Read the test-free evaluation and normalization carefully; it underpins both the benchmark’s credibility and the RL reward signal.
- Then skim GRPO training details and error analysis (if provided) to understand what the RL signal is actually pushing the model to do.
Treat it as a reference for scalable code supervision and RL evaluation design rather than a pretraining-recipe paper.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据构造与 GRPO 训练细节：把“开发者最终提交”变成可规模化监督很实用；但指标/判定口径可能偏脆，先当强 baseline+数据资产读。
recommendation.en: Read for the dataset construction and GRPO training signal: turning “final developer commits” into scalable supervision is genuinely useful, but the evaluation protocol may be brittle—treat it as a strong baseline + data asset.

paper.title: MM-Conv: A Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Context-Aware Grounding in 3D Dialogue
paper.abstract: Grounding language in the physical world requires AI systems to interpret references that emerge dynamically during conversation. While current vision-language models (VLMs) excel at static image tasks, they struggle to resolve ambiguous expressions in spontaneous, multi-turn dialogue. We address this gap by introducing (1) a benchmark for referential communication in dynamic 3D environments, built from 6.7 hours of egocentric VR interaction with synchronized speech, motion, gaze, and 3D scene g

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM在动态3D环境的多轮对话中难以解析歧义指代表达，缺乏面向3D对话场景的基准数据集。
summary.importance: 数据贡献+基准贡献：发布了MM-Conv数据集（6.7小时VR第一人称交互，含语音/运动/凝视/3D几何的多模态数据，4200+人工验证指代表达），建立了3D对话中语言接地的benchmark。
summary.technical_approach: 两阶段接地pipeline：先通过上下文重写解决会话歧义，再进行视觉定位；对比了端到端方法和模块化方法。
summary.experiments: 基准包含全指代、部分指代和代词指代三种类型；上下文重写使接地性能平均提升11-22个百分点；重写后GroundingDINO在代词指代上达到56.7%，接近最佳端到端基线的两倍。
summary.authors_note: KTH皇家理工学院团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLMs struggle to resolve ambiguous referring expressions in spontaneous multi-turn dialogue within dynamic 3D environments, and no benchmark dataset exists for this specific setting.
summary_en.importance: Data and benchmark contribution: MM-Conv dataset (6.7 hours of egocentric VR interaction with speech, motion, gaze, and 3D geometry; 4,200+ manually verified referring expressions), establishing a benchmark for language grounding in 3D dialogue.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-stage grounding pipeline: contextual rewriting to resolve conversational ambiguity first, then visual localization; compares end-to-end vs modular approaches.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmark spans full, partitive, and pronominal reference types; contextual rewriting improves grounding by 11-22pp on average; GroundingDINO reaches 56.7% on pronominals after rewriting, nearly doubling the best end-to-end baseline.
summary_en.authors_note: KTH Royal Institute of Technology team.

recommendation.zh: 3D多模态对话基准，对LLM基座预训练研究无直接关联，但数据集的构建方法（VR环境多模态同步采集）对多模态数据设计有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: 3D multimodal dialogue benchmark. Not directly relevant to LLM pretraining, but the dataset construction methodology (synchronized multimodal capture in VR) has some reference value for multimodal data design.

institutions: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm

paper.title: WCXB: A Multi-Type Web Content Extraction Benchmark
paper.abstract: Web content extraction - isolating a page's main content from surrounding boilerplate - is a prerequisite for search indexing, retrieval-augmented generation, NLP dataset construction, and large language model training. Progress in this area has been constrained by the limitations of existing evaluation benchmarks, which are small (100-800 pages), restricted to news articles, or based on web pages from over a decade ago. We introduce the Web Content Extraction Benchmark (WCXB), a dataset of 2,00

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“再做一个网页正文抽取器”，而是先把评测地基补上。现有 benchmark 主要有三个问题：规模小，页面类型过窄，且大多来自十多年前的网页形态，导致研究者很难判断抽取器在现代 Web、尤其是非新闻类页面上的真实表现。论文把问题重新定义为：面向现代网页正文抽取，如何构建一个覆盖结构差异、而不是只覆盖语义主题差异的 benchmark，使抽取方法能在文章、论坛、商品页、文档页、服务页等不同 HTML 结构上被可靠比较。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在数据入口，而不在模型本身。大规模网页语料仍是很多基座模型的重要来源，正文抽取质量会直接影响训练 token 的纯度、重复模式、模板噪声比例，以及后续 tokenizer 统计和数据配比。WCXB 的价值有三层。第一，它把网页抽取从“新闻正文抽取”扩展成“多结构网页内容抽取”，这更接近真实 crawl 分布。第二，它显式纳入 SPA/需 JS 渲染页面，并把“识别无可用 server-side 内容”也视为能力的一部分，这对现代数据管线很关键。第三，它提供了按页面类型拆分的基线结果，能帮助数据工程团队判断某类页面是否该单独建规则、单独训练模型，还是直接过滤。它不是直接改进 pretrain loss 的论文，但对高质量 web pretraining corpus 的构建有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 benchmark 设计，而不是新抽取算法。论文先提出一个七类页面 taxonomy：article、forum、product、collection、listing、documentation、service。这个分类不是按内容主题分，而是按会影响抽取行为的 HTML 结构分。比如 collection 和 listing 都是多项内容页，但前者更像商品卡片网格，正文常藏在 JSON-LD 或短描述里；后者则往往每个条目都有较长文本摘要。这样的划分更贴近抽取器失败模式。

数据构建上，页面来自 Common Crawl、ChatNoir 和人工补充，最终覆盖 2008 个页面、1613 个域名，域名分布较分散，避免 benchmark 被少数站点模板主导。页面时间在 2025 年 9 月到 2026 年 3 月之间，强调现代 HTML5、响应式布局和 JS 框架。抓取时同时支持 headless Chrome 和直接 HTTP 请求，以兼顾 CSR/SSR 页面。数据中保留了 SPA 标记；对于必须依赖 JS 才能看到正文的页面，ground truth 为空，目的是测试系统能否避免从壳页面里误抽导航和模板文本。

标注方案也比较讲究。每个样本不仅有 title、author、publish_date、main_content，还有 with/without 片段约束。main_content 统一为纯文本，不保留 Markdown/HTML 格式，评测重点放在内容边界和完整性，而不是格式还原。标注流程采用 LLM 起草、脚本校验、多轮 frontier model 复核，再加人工抽检的多阶段流程。这里的取舍很明确：网页正文标注成本高，完全人工很难扩到 2k 量级；而纯 LLM 自动标注又不够稳，所以作者用多重校验把 LLM 标注变成“可控的半自动标注”。

从研究设计看，这篇论文最重要的技术判断是：网页抽取的主要泛化难点不只是站点差异，而是页面结构类型差异。因此 benchmark 的组织单位应优先是 page type，而不是 topic 或 source dataset。这一点比单纯扩大样本数更有信息量。
summary.experiments:
论文给出了 13 个抽取系统的基线，其中包括 11 个启发式方法和 2 个神经方法。数据集规模为 2008 页，其中开发集 1497 页，测试集 511 页，覆盖 1613 个域名。最长标注正文达到 49,617 字符，说明 benchmark 不只包含短新闻页，也包含长文档和复杂论坛页。

从全文给出的实验设定看，作者重点不是追求一个统一总分，而是比较不同方法在不同 page type 上的性能差异，并验证“genre-dependent”这一老结论在现代网页上依然成立，而且更明显。启发式方法在 article 类页面上通常还能维持可用表现，但在 forum、documentation、service、product 等结构更复杂或模板更重的页面上容易失败。神经方法整体更稳，但也并非在所有类型上都占优，尤其当页面需要识别‘无 server-side 正文’时，误抽 boilerplate 仍是常见问题。

如果从预训练数据构建角度读实验，最有用的信息不是谁第一，而是失败模式：有些方法偏向过抽，导致导航、推荐位、页脚混入正文；有些方法偏向欠抽，丢掉论坛回复、商品规格、文档代码块或分段说明。对训练语料来说，这两类错误影响不同。过抽会放大模板噪声和重复 token，欠抽则损失高信息密度内容。论文通过 with/without 片段和 page-type 细分，基本把这两类错误都显式化了。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不需要逐段精读算法细节。优先看四部分。

第一，看 Introduction 和 taxonomy 定义。重点理解作者为什么按结构分七类，而不是沿用新闻/博客/电商这类语义分类。

第二，看 Dataset Construction。这里决定 benchmark 是否可信，尤其是页面来源、域名去重、JS 渲染处理、SPA 空标注策略，以及 ground truth 的字段设计。

第三，看 annotation pipeline。要留意 LLM-assisted drafting、自动校验、四轮 frontier model review、人工抽检之间如何分工。做大规模数据工程的人会关心这套流程能否迁移到别的网页清洗任务。

第四，看 baseline result 表和按 page type 的拆分图。阅读时不要只看平均分，要看哪些类型最难、哪些方法在某些类型上系统性失效。

如果时间有限，30 分钟左右可以抓住主要信息；如果你在做 web pretraining corpus 或 HTML-to-text 清洗，建议把 taxonomy、标注协议和 error analysis 部分仔细看一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about proposing yet another extractor. It addresses a more basic issue: current web content extraction benchmarks are too small, too article-centric, and too outdated to reflect modern web crawling conditions. The actual problem is how to build an evaluation set that captures extraction-relevant structural diversity in contemporary HTML, so systems can be compared on articles, forums, product pages, documentation, service pages, and other page types that appear in real pretraining crawls.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is upstream but concrete. Web extraction quality directly affects corpus cleanliness, boilerplate contamination, template repetition, tokenizer statistics, and the effective information density of training tokens. WCXB matters for three reasons. First, it reframes extraction from a narrow article task into a multi-structure web extraction problem. Second, it explicitly includes SPA-style pages and treats correct detection of missing server-side content as part of the task, which is important for modern crawl pipelines. Third, it reports page-type-specific baselines, which is useful for deciding whether a data pipeline needs specialized rules, learned extractors, or outright filtering for certain page classes. This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant infrastructure for building cleaner web corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main contribution is benchmark design. The paper defines a seven-type taxonomy: article, forum, product, collection, listing, documentation, and service. The key design choice is that these categories are based on HTML structure and extraction behavior rather than semantic topic. That matters because extraction failures are often driven by layout and DOM organization, not by subject matter. For example, collection and listing pages both contain multiple items, but they differ in where useful text lives and how much text each item carries.

The dataset is built from Common Crawl, ChatNoir, and manual curation, ending with 2,008 pages from 1,613 domains. Domain concentration is low, which reduces template memorization effects. Pages were collected in late 2025 to early 2026, so the benchmark reflects modern HTML5, responsive layouts, and JavaScript-heavy sites. Acquisition uses both headless Chrome and direct HTTP fetching. SPA pages are retained and flagged; when content is unavailable without client-side rendering, the ground truth is intentionally empty so systems are tested on whether they avoid extracting shell boilerplate.

Annotation is richer than plain extracted text. Each sample includes title, author, publish date, main content, and short must-include / must-exclude snippets. Main content is stored as plain text rather than HTML or Markdown, which keeps evaluation focused on content boundaries and completeness instead of formatting fidelity. The annotation pipeline combines LLM drafting, automated verification, multiple frontier-model review passes, and manual checks. The practical idea is to use LLMs for scale while constraining them with validation and targeted review.

The most important methodological insight is that benchmark organization should follow structural extraction difficulty, not just source diversity or topic diversity. That choice gives the benchmark diagnostic value rather than only aggregate coverage.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates 13 extraction systems, including 11 heuristic methods and 2 neural ones. The benchmark contains 2,008 pages in total, split into a 1,497-page development set and a 511-page held-out test set, spanning 1,613 domains. The longest annotated main-content field reaches 49,617 characters, indicating that the dataset includes long documentation and complex forum-like pages rather than only short articles.

The experimental emphasis is not on a single leaderboard number. The useful result is the page-type breakdown, which shows that performance remains strongly type-dependent on the modern web. Heuristic extractors are often still competitive on article pages, but they degrade on forums, documentation, service pages, and product pages where DOM structure is more heterogeneous or template-heavy. Neural systems are generally more robust, but they are not uniformly dominant, especially when the task requires recognizing that no meaningful server-side content is present.

For pretraining data construction, the most informative part is the failure taxonomy. Some systems over-extract and pull in navigation, recommendations, cookie banners, or footer text. Others under-extract and miss forum replies, product specifications, code blocks, or sectioned documentation content. These two error modes have different downstream effects: over-extraction increases boilerplate and repeated template tokens, while under-extraction throws away high-value content. The benchmark design makes both visible through page-type splits and with/without constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading selectively if you work on web data pipelines. Start with the introduction and the page-type taxonomy. The key question is why the authors classify pages by extraction behavior rather than by semantic genre.

Then read the dataset construction section carefully. Pay attention to source diversity, domain deduplication, JavaScript rendering handling, the SPA-empty-ground-truth policy, and the annotation schema.

Next, inspect the annotation pipeline. The useful part is how LLM drafting is combined with automated checks and multi-pass review to make large-scale labeling feasible without fully trusting the model.

Finally, look at the baseline tables and per-type breakdowns. Do not focus only on the average score. The real signal is which page types are consistently hard and which systems fail in systematic ways.

A quick pass takes about 30 minutes. If you are building web pretraining corpora or HTML-to-text cleaning systems, the taxonomy, annotation protocol, and error analysis deserve a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 对做数据管线的人很实用：页面类型覆盖比旧基准更贴近今天的 web，能把“模板噪声进预训练”这类问题量化；先看数据构成与标注流程。
recommendation.en: Practical for data-pipeline work: broader, modern page-type coverage makes boilerplate contamination measurable; start with dataset composition and the labeling pipeline.

paper.title: MONET: A Massive, Open, Non-redundant and Enriched Text-to-image dataset
paper.abstract: Training large text-to-image models requires high-quality, curated datasets with diverse content and detailed captions. Yet the cost and complexity of collecting, filtering, deduplicating, and re-captioning such corpora at scale hinders open and reproducible research in the field.
