summary.core_problem: 解决开放文本到图像训练中，高质量大规模图文数据难以公开复现的问题，尤其是采集、去重、过滤和重描述成本过高。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是数据资产与数据处理流水线：从 29 亿原始图文对中构建约 1.049 亿开放图文对，并附带 embeddings 与注释。对研究者的价值在于观察大规模图文数据清洗、去重、recaption 的工程配方，而不是语言模型本身。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 MONET 数据集，采用多阶段流水线：安全过滤、域过滤、精确与近重复去除、使用多个 VLM 进行短到长描述的重标注，并加入合成样本增强。数据以 Apache 2.0 开放，并提供预计算特征以降低训练门槛。
summary.experiments: 用 MONET 独立训练一个 4B 参数 latent diffusion 模型，在 GenEval 和 DPG 上达到有竞争力的结果，以验证数据集质量。摘要未给出更细的对比对象和提升幅度，但实验重点显然是证明“只靠该数据集也能训出像样的 T2I 模型”。
summary.authors_note: Jasper Research 团队。若关注开放图文数据构建、去重和 recaption pipeline，这篇有一定参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of open, reproducible, large-scale, high-quality image-text corpora for training text-to-image models, where collection, filtering, deduplication, and recaptioning are expensive.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a data asset plus a data-processing pipeline: building an open 104.9M image-text dataset from 2.9B raw pairs, with embeddings and annotations included. The value is mostly in the engineering recipe for large-scale multimodal data curation rather than language modeling itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: MONET is built through a multi-stage pipeline: safety filtering, domain filtering, exact and near-duplicate removal, recaptioning with multiple VLMs from short to long descriptions, and synthetic augmentation. The dataset is released under Apache 2.0 with precomputed features.
summary_en.experiments: The authors train a 4B-parameter latent diffusion model exclusively on MONET and report competitive GenEval and DPG scores, aiming to show that the dataset alone is sufficient to train a capable T2I model. The abstract does not provide detailed baselines or margins.
summary_en.authors_note: From Jasper Research. Useful if you care about open image-text data construction, deduplication, and recaptioning pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但数据清洗、去重、recaption 这套图文配方可迁到多模态预训练；只看数据流水线和去重策略即可。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the curation, dedup, and recaption recipe is transferable to multimodal pretraining; read the data pipeline, not the whole paper.

paper.title: PixVerve: Advancing Native UHR Image Generation to 100MP with a Large-Scale High-Quality Dataset
paper.abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) models have recently seen notable progress around 1K and 2K resolution. With the extreme desire for better visual experience and the rapid development of imaging technology, the demand for Ultra-High-Resolution (UHR) image generation has grown significantly. However, UHR image generation poses great challenges due to the scarcity and complexity of high-resolution content. In this paper, we first introduce PixVerve-95K, a high-quality, open-source UHR T2I dataset curated with

summary.core_problem: 如何把文本到图像模型推进到“原生”100MP超高分辨率生成，并解决UHR数据稀缺与评测缺位。
summary.importance: 数据集+benchmark+训练方案的组合贡献；对“高分辨率生成的训练稳定性/数据管线/评测”有工程参考，但不直接触及LLM预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 构建PixVerve-95K（每张≥100MP）并提供七维标注；在此基础上提出三种训练方案把多种T2I foundation model扩展到原生100MP生成；评测上结合传统指标与基于多模态LLM的自动评估，提出PixVerve-Bench。
summary.experiments: 核心规模信息来自摘要：95K张≥100MP图文数据；对“多种T2I基础模型”做100MP训练与对比，并用PixVerve-Bench评估，但摘要未给出具体模型参数量、训练算力与定量提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Enabling native 100MP text-to-image generation while addressing the scarcity of ultra-high-resolution data and the lack of proper evaluation.
summary_en.importance: A combined dataset+benchmark+training-scheme contribution; useful engineering reference for UHR generation pipelines and evaluation, but not directly about LLM pretraining paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Releases PixVerve-95K (each image ≥100MP) with 7D annotations; proposes three training schemes to extend multiple T2I foundation models to native 100MP; introduces PixVerve-Bench using both conventional metrics and MLLM-based assessment.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract: 95K UHR image-text pairs (≥100MP). Trains multiple T2I foundation models for 100MP generation and evaluates on PixVerve-Bench; model sizes/compute and exact deltas are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“UHR数据管线+评测”资料库：只需看数据筛选/标注维度和LLM评测设计，训练方案细节未必可复用。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a UHR dataset/pipeline + evaluation reference—skim the curation/annotation and the MLLM-based eval; the training recipes may be highly model-specific.

paper.title: ThoughtTrace: Understanding User Thoughts in Real-World LLM Interactions
paper.abstract: Conversational AI has now reached billions of users, yet existing datasets capture only what people say, not what they think. We introduce ThoughtTrace, the first large-scale dataset that pairs real-world multi-turn human--AI conversations with users' self-reported thoughts: their reasons for sending prompts and reactions to assistant responses. ThoughtTrace comprises 1,058 users, 2,155 conversations, 17,058 turns, and 10,174 thought annotations collected across 20 language models. Our analysis

summary.core_problem: ThoughtTrace 关注人机对话中不可见的用户心理状态：用户为什么发送某条消息，以及用户如何反应于模型回复。普通对话数据只记录用户说了什么，缺少隐藏目标、约束、满意度和下一步行为动因，导致训练和评测信号偏表层。
summary.importance: 这篇论文更接近 post-train 和对齐数据研究，而不是基座预训练。对预训练研究的启发在于数据层面：同一段交互可以有显式 utterance，也可以有 latent intent / reaction 标注。后者可能成为用户模拟、偏好建模、指令跟随数据筛选、长程对话训练中的补充监督信号。它也提醒基座模型评测不能只看最终回答，还要看模型是否理解用户未明说的约束和阶段性反馈。
summary.technical_approach: 数据集包含 1,058 名用户、2,155 段对话、17,058 个交互 turn、10,174 条 thought annotations，覆盖 20 个语言模型。标注分为两类：reason，即用户发送消息的原因；reaction，即用户看到助手回复后的内部反应。采集流程包括用户同意、教程与测验、开放式真实任务对话、逐 turn 思考标注、任务后描述，以及人口统计信息。论文分析了三类性质：对话是否长程且话题多样；thought 与显式 message 的语义差异，以及前沿模型是否能从上下文推断 thought；thought 对后续用户行为预测和对齐训练是否有帮助。方法重点不在新模型结构，而在把“用户内部认知轨迹”作为一种可训练、可评测的数据模态。

summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看数据采集协议，尤其是 reason / reaction 的定义和标注时机；再看 thought 与 message 的语义差异分析，判断这些标注是否真的提供新增信息；最后看 utility experiments，重点确认 +41.7% 和 +25.6% 是在哪些任务、哪些基线、哪些模型上得到的。若关注训练数据，应额外检查隐私处理、用户群体分布、标注负担，以及 thought 是否会引入自我报告偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: ThoughtTrace studies the hidden user state in human-AI conversations: why a user sends a message and how the user reacts to an assistant response. Standard conversation logs only contain observable utterances. They often miss latent goals, constraints, dissatisfaction, and the reasons behind the next turn.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly relevant to post-training, alignment data, and user modeling rather than foundation-model pretraining. Its useful signal for model training is the separation between surface utterances and latent intent or reaction. Such annotations can support user simulation, preference modeling, instruction-data filtering, and long-horizon dialogue training. It also suggests that evaluation should not only score the assistant’s final answer, but also whether the model tracks implicit constraints and evolving user expectations.
summary_en.technical_approach: ThoughtTrace contains 1,058 users, 2,155 conversations, 17,058 turns, and 10,174 thought annotations collected across 20 language models. The annotations are split into two types: reasons, which explain why a user sends a message, and reactions, which capture the user’s internal response to an assistant message. The collection pipeline includes consent, a tutorial and comprehension quiz, open-ended real-world tasks, turn-aligned thought annotations, post-task descriptions, and demographic metadata. The analysis asks whether the conversations are long-horizon and topically diverse, whether thoughts differ semantically from messages, whether frontier models can infer them from context, and whether they improve downstream behavior prediction and alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical asset is the dataset scale: 1,058 users, 2,155 conversations, 17,058 interaction turns, and 10,174 thought annotations from conversations with 20 language models. The reported analyses show that thoughts are semantically distinct from messages and difficult for strong models to infer from context. Utility experiments report a +41.7% relative gain for predicting user behavior and a +25.6% win-rate improvement when thoughts are used as fine-grained alignment signals. The excerpt does not include the full model setups or tables, so the exact task definitions, baselines, and significance tests should be checked in the experimental sections.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Start with the data collection protocol, especially the definitions and timing of reason and reaction annotations. Then read the analyses comparing thoughts with observable messages, since that determines whether the annotations add real signal. Finally inspect the utility experiments and verify where the +41.7% and +25.6% numbers come from: task setup, baselines, models, and evaluation procedure. For training-data use, also check privacy treatment, participant distribution, annotation burden, and possible self-report bias.

paper.title: One Turn Too Late: Response-Aware Defense Against Hidden Malicious Intent in Multi-Turn Dialogue
paper.abstract: Hidden malicious intent in multi-turn dialogue poses a growing threat to deployed large language models (LLMs). Rather than exposing a harmful objective in a single prompt, increasingly capable attackers can distribute their intent across multiple benign-looking turns. Recent studies show that even modern commercial models with advanced guardrails remain vulnerable to such attacks despite advances in safety alignment and external guardrails. In this work, we address this challenge by detecting t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多轮对话里的隐蔽恶意意图检测，但目标定义比常见的“判整段对话是否有害”更细。作者关心的是：在第 t 轮，若把当前候选回复交给用户，是否会让此前累积的信息第一次达到“足以实施有害行为”的阈值。这里的关键不是只看用户问题，而是把模型即将输出的候选回复也纳入判断，因为同一串用户提问，在模型只给高层概述时可能仍然安全，在模型补上可执行细节时才真正越线。论文把这个点形式化为 first harm-enabling turn，也就是最早的闭合点检测问题。
summary.importance: 对安全研究而言，这不是一个普通的 guardrail 分类器改进，而是把多轮攻击防御的目标从静态合规判断改成了时序化、响应感知的干预决策。这个改动有两层意义。第一，它指出 query-only 监控存在结构性上限：看不到候选回复，就无法区分“同样的上下文，给不同粒度回答时风险不同”的情况。第二，它把安全-可用性的权衡具体化为“既不能放过真正完成闭环的那一轮，也不能过早拒绝仍属探索性的对话”。从训练范式上看，这也很像把安全监控从 outcome label 推向 process-level supervision，对做对齐、在线监控、甚至 response reranking 的人都有参考价值。若从基座研究角度看，它不属于预训练方法，但对 post-train 安全信号设计、过程奖励构造、以及多轮交互中的 credit assignment 都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两部分组成：数据构建和响应感知监控器 TurnGate。先说任务设定。系统里有用户、基础助手和防御器三方。每一轮用户给出 q_t，基础助手先生成候选回复 r~_t，防御器在看到完整历史和当前候选回复后，决定 Pass 还是 Block。若 Block，则用拒答替换候选回复。作者采用单回合 episode 设定，把目标定义为尽可能在 first harm-enabling turn 上拦截。

数据方面，作者构建了 MTID。它不是从静态指令集直接拼出来，而是从针对前沿闭源模型的 adaptive multi-turn attack rollouts 派生而来，再配上 matched benign dialogues 用来测 over-refusal，并显式标注 first harm-enabling turns。这个标注设计很关键，因为普通的对话级有害/无害标签无法训练出“何时该拦”的精细边界。

模型方面，TurnGate 以 Qwen3-4B 为底座。训练分两阶段。第一阶段是基于细粒度 turn-level 标签的监督微调，让模型先学会在每一轮做 Pass/Block 判定。第二阶段进一步做 multi-turn RL，并使用 turn-level process rewards。按作者的描述，这个奖励不是只看最终是否拦住整段攻击，而是鼓励模型在正确的闭合点拦截，同时惩罚过早拒绝和过晚放行。这样做的原因很直接：如果只用最终成败做奖励，模型容易学成过度保守的策略；而 process reward 把时间定位误差也纳入优化目标，更贴合真实部署需求。

和现有方法相比，差异主要有三点。第一，区别于标准 guardrail 或 alignment policy，它不是对单轮请求做静态合规判断，而是对“历史+候选回复”做时序决策。第二，区别于只看用户 query 的监控器，它显式利用 response-aware 信息。第三，区别于只做 dialogue-level judgment 的方法，它把监督粒度下沉到 turn level，并用 RL 去优化安全与可用性的边界位置，而不是只优化最终标签。
summary.experiments:
从引言和任务描述能确认，实验分为 offline evaluation 和 closed-loop online battles 两类，并且覆盖跨领域、跨攻击管线、跨目标模型的泛化测试。核心结论是：TurnGate 相比 response-blind baselines 有更好的 safety-utility trade-off，既能更早、更准地拦住真正完成有害闭环的轮次，也能减少 benign 对话上的 over-refusal。

全文片段里已经明确的实验要点有几项。其一，训练底座是 Qwen3-4B。其二，数据来自对 frontier commercial models 的自适应攻击 rollout，而不是单一模板攻击，因此评测更接近真实对抗。其三，作者特别强调 matched benign dialogues，这意味着实验不是只看 attack success reduction，也同时看误拒率。其四，在线 battle 设计说明攻击者会根据防御行为继续适配，而不是离线固定样本，这对验证多轮防御是否真的有效很重要。

不过，当前给出的全文片段没有包含完整结果表、具体数值、各基线名称、消融细节和统计显著性信息，因此无法负责任地填入提升百分比、AUC、ASR 降幅、误拒率绝对值等数字。精读时应重点补齐：1）response-aware 相对 query-only 的增益幅度；2）SFT-only 相对 SFT+RL 的增益；3）在不同攻击域和不同目标模型上的迁移表现；4）first harm-enabling turn 标注一致性与误差分布；5）若有 ablation，候选回复、历史长度、拒答替换策略分别贡献多少。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看问题定义和 threat model，再看数据标注协议，最后看 RL 奖励设计与在线对抗实验。最值得精读的地方有四个。

第一，看 first harm-enabling turn 的定义是否足够可操作。这里决定了任务是不是一个稳定的学习目标。要特别留意作者如何处理“信息已接近充分但仍缺关键一步”的边界案例，以及标注者是否依据可执行性、危险性还是政策文本来判定闭合。

第二，看 MTID 的构造流程。重点不是数据量，而是攻击 rollout 如何生成、是否覆盖不同危害域、benign 匹配是按主题还是按表面形式匹配、以及是否存在由攻击器风格泄漏带来的捷径。

第三，看 RL 的 process reward。这里是方法真正可能带来增益的地方。需要确认奖励是否显式区分过早拦截、恰当拦截、过晚拦截三种情况，是否有 reward hacking 风险，以及训练时是否用到了环境模拟或固定攻击轨迹。

第四，看 online battle 的协议。多轮安全方法常在离线分类上看起来不错，但一旦攻击者适配就失效。要重点看攻击者是否知道防御器存在、是否能根据拒答重写策略、以及评测终止条件如何设定。

如果时间有限，优先读 Introduction、Problem Formulation、数据集章节、RL 训练章节和在线实验章节。图表上优先看任务示意图、主结果表、response-aware ablation、以及错误案例分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies hidden malicious intent in multi-turn dialogue, but with a sharper objective than standard harmful/benign classification. The goal is to detect the earliest turn at which releasing the current candidate response would make the accumulated interaction sufficient for harmful action. This is a response-aware closure problem, not just a user-intent problem. The same sequence of user queries may remain acceptable if the assistant stays high-level, yet become dangerous once the model provides the missing actionable detail. The paper formalizes this as detecting the first harm-enabling turn before the response is delivered.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is not merely a better safety classifier. It reframes multi-turn defense from static compliance judgment to temporally localized intervention. That matters for two reasons. First, it exposes a structural limitation of query-only monitors: without access to the candidate response, they cannot tell whether the current turn actually completes the harmful plan. Second, it turns the safety-utility trade-off into a precise decision problem: block too late and the attack succeeds; block too early and benign exploratory dialogue is unnecessarily refused. For researchers working on alignment, online monitoring, process supervision, or response reranking, this is a useful formulation shift. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to post-training signal design, multi-turn credit assignment, and response-conditioned safety control.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method combines a new dataset with a response-aware monitor called TurnGate. The interaction protocol has three parties: user, base assistant, and defender. At turn t, the user sends q_t, the assistant produces a candidate response r~_t, and the defender observes the full history plus r~_t before deciding Pass or Block. If blocked, the candidate response is replaced by a refusal. The learning target is to intervene exactly at the first harm-enabling turn.

For data, the authors build MTID, derived from adaptive multi-turn attack rollouts against frontier commercial models. The dataset also includes matched benign dialogues to measure over-refusal, and explicit annotations of first harm-enabling turns. This annotation choice is central. Dialogue-level harmfulness labels are too coarse for learning when to intervene.

TurnGate is trained on top of Qwen3-4B in two stages. Stage one is supervised fine-tuning on turn-level labels. Stage two adds multi-turn reinforcement learning with turn-level process rewards. The reward is designed to favor timely interception at the closure turn while penalizing both premature refusal and delayed blocking. This is an important design choice: optimizing only final attack success would likely push the monitor toward overly conservative behavior, whereas process rewards align the objective with precise temporal localization.

Relative to prior approaches, the differences are clear. It is not a single-turn policy compliance checker. It is not a query-only monitor. And it is not trained only on dialogue-level judgments. The novelty lies in response-aware turn-level supervision plus RL for optimizing the intervention boundary itself.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text excerpts, the evaluation includes both offline benchmarks and closed-loop online battles against adaptive attackers, with tests spanning domains, attacker pipelines, and target models. The headline result is that TurnGate improves the safety-utility trade-off over response-blind baselines: it blocks harmful closure turns more accurately while reducing over-refusal on benign conversations.

Several experimental facts are explicit in the text. The monitor is built from Qwen3-4B. MTID is constructed from adaptive attacks on frontier commercial models rather than static prompt templates, which makes the setting more realistic. The inclusion of matched benign dialogues means the paper evaluates utility loss, not only attack suppression. The online battle setup also matters: the attacker can adapt during interaction, so the results are more informative than fixed offline classification.

That said, the provided excerpt does not include the main result tables, exact baseline names, ablation numbers, or confidence intervals. So it would be unsafe to invent concrete gains. When reading the full paper, the key numbers to extract are: the margin of response-aware monitoring over query-only baselines; the gain from SFT to SFT+RL; transfer across attack domains and target models; annotation consistency for first harm-enabling turns; and any ablations on candidate-response access, context length, or refusal replacement policy.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the task definition and threat model, then move to the annotation protocol for MTID, and only then read the RL objective and online evaluation. Four parts deserve close attention.

First, inspect how the first harm-enabling turn is defined. This determines whether the task is learnable and reproducible. Pay attention to borderline cases where the dialogue is nearly sufficient but still missing one critical detail, and to whether the labeling criterion is based on actionability, policy violation, or practical misuse potential.

Second, read the MTID construction carefully. The important questions are how the adaptive rollouts are generated, how broad the harm domains are, how benign dialogues are matched, and whether the monitor could exploit stylistic artifacts from the attack generator instead of learning genuine closure detection.

Third, focus on the process reward in RL. This is likely where much of the gain comes from. Check whether the reward explicitly distinguishes early, correct, and late intervention; whether there is room for reward hacking; and whether training uses a simulated environment or fixed trajectories.

Fourth, examine the online battle protocol. Multi-turn safety methods often look good offline and then fail once the attacker adapts. Look for whether the attacker is aware of the defender, whether it can rewrite strategy after refusals, and how success or termination is defined.

If time is limited, prioritize the Introduction, Problem Formulation, dataset section, RL training section, and online experiments. The most informative figures and tables should be the task illustration, the main safety-utility results, the response-aware ablation, and the error analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它把安全从“识别坏输入”改成“识别何时形成可执行闭环”，对对话状态建模和 refusal data 设计有实打实启发；先看任务定义和 MTID 标注协议。

summary.core_problem: 解决 chart image 到可执行绘图代码生成时过度依赖 Python、缺少多语言等价监督的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是数据和轻量适配方法：Chart2NCode 提供 176K 图表及 Python、R、LaTeX 对齐脚本，能支持更贴近实际编辑需求的 chart-to-code 评测与训练。

summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了广泛实验，但未给出完整模型规模、训练 token、baseline 名称或提升幅度；可确认的是任务覆盖 Python、R、LaTeX 三种输出语言，并围绕视觉等价的 chart reproduction 评估。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Singapore Management University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets chart-to-code generation beyond Python-only settings, where the same chart should be reproducible as executable scripts in multiple plotting languages.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is a dataset and adaptation contribution: Chart2NCode contains 176K charts aligned with visually equivalent Python, R, and LaTeX scripts, enabling multi-language supervision for editable chart reconstruction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The dataset is built with a metadata-to-template pipeline, rendering verification, and human quality checks. The model, CharLuMA, follows a LLaVA-style design and adds a language-conditioned mixture of low-rank subspaces to the multimodal projector, sharing chart understanding while routing generation toward the target language.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments but does not expose model sizes, data scale beyond the dataset, named baselines, or numeric gains. The confirmed setup evaluates chart reproduction across Python, R, and LaTeX.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Singapore Management University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 到结构化代码输出的数据点可扫，CharLuMA 更像任务适配模块，不会改变预训练侧 prior。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance as a VLM-to-structured-code data point; CharLuMA is task adaptation rather than a pretraining-level idea.

This challenge is driven not only by the lack of datasets that align prompts with the exact text and layout expected in the image, but also by the absence of effective metrics for evaluating layout quality. To address these issues, we introduce TextGround4M, a large-scale dataset of over 4 million promp

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是文生图模型的文字渲染与布局对齐问题：模型不仅要生成正确的文字内容，还要把 prompt 中指定的多个文本片段放在正确空间位置。现有数据通常只有 OCR 文本或框，缺少“prompt 中哪段指令对应图中哪段文字和位置”的显式对齐。
summary.importance: 这项工作与 LLM 预训练的交集在于 AR 图像生成和统一多模态建模的数据监督。TextGround4M 提供了 span-level 文本内容、prompt grounding 和 bounding box 的联合标注，可作为训练 autoregressive T2I 或 Chameleon/Janus 这类统一模型的高质量视觉文本数据。它的价值不在通用语言能力，而在提醒多模态预训练数据需要更细的条件—内容—空间三元对齐；仅靠图文 caption 对很难学好精确文本渲染。
summary.technical_approach: TextGround4M 包含约 4.1M prompt-image pairs，每个样本标注 prompt 所蕴含的可见文字 span 及其 bounding boxes。数据管线从 11.7M 原始图文对开始，其中约 8M 来自公开数据集，包括 Mario10M、Anyword3M、TextScenesHQ 等，另有约 3.7M 来自 CommonCrawl 挖掘。作者使用 GPT-4o 构造领域—主题—子主题层级查询，用于补充公开数据中不足的文本密集和结构化场景；再结合 OCR、VLM captioning、规则对齐、合并和多阶段质量过滤，筛出 prompt-grounded 文本 span。训练方法是 Layout-posting：针对 AR T2I 模型，在训练时先预测 image tokens，再把结构化布局 token 作为后续 autoregressive target，包括渲染短语和坐标。这样不改模型结构，也不在推理时增加额外输入；布局监督作为训练期的隐式约束进入模型。
summary.experiments: 工作构造了按文本 span 数量和 prompt 复杂度分层的 benchmark，并提出两个 layout-aware 指标，用于评估文字内容保真和空间位置质量。作者在 Janus-Pro 上验证 Layout-posting，称其能带来接近 pre-layout 方式的改进，同时保持自由形式输入，不增加推理开销。给出的内容没有包含具体指标表和数值提升，因此需要在全文实验部分确认：商业模型和开源模型的差距、Janus-Pro 微调后的 OCR 准确率、布局指标变化，以及多 span 场景下性能下降曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看数据构建流程图和过滤规则，判断标注噪声是否可控；再看 Layout-posting 的 token 格式，确认坐标离散化、span 顺序和 image token 之后追加监督的训练细节。实验部分重点看新指标定义、难度分层 benchmark，以及 Janus-Pro 的主结果和消融。对预训练研究更有用的是数据 schema 和训练目标，而不是海报生成这类应用场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses prompt-grounded text rendering in text-to-image models. The model must render the specified text correctly and place multiple text spans at the intended locations. Existing datasets often provide OCR text or boxes, but they do not explicitly align prompt phrases with the corresponding rendered text and spatial regions.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining lies in data supervision for autoregressive image generation and unified multimodal modeling. TextGround4M provides joint supervision over text spans, prompt grounding, and bounding boxes, which is useful for AR T2I models and unified systems such as Chameleon- or Janus-style models. The main lesson is that multimodal pretraining data needs fine-grained condition-content-space alignment; generic image-caption pairs are too weak for precise text rendering.
summary_en.technical_approach: TextGround4M contains about 4.1M prompt-image pairs. Each sample annotates visible text spans entailed by the prompt and their bounding boxes. The pipeline starts from 11.7M raw image-text pairs: around 8M from public sources such as Mario10M, Anyword3M, and TextScenesHQ, plus about 3.7M mined from CommonCrawl. GPT-4o is used to expand a domain-topic-subtopic taxonomy into search queries, improving coverage of text-rich and structurally diverse scenes. OCR, VLM captioning, rule-based alignment, merging, and multi-stage filtering are then used to identify prompt-grounded text spans. The training method, Layout-posting, targets AR T2I models. During training, the model first predicts image tokens and then predicts structured layout tokens containing rendered phrases and coordinates. This adds layout supervision without architectural changes and without extra inference-time inputs.
summary_en.experiments: The work builds a difficulty-aware benchmark stratified by the number of text spans and prompt complexity, and introduces two layout-aware metrics for evaluating content fidelity and spatial quality. Experiments are reported on Janus-Pro. Layout-posting is described as achieving improvements comparable to pre-layout supervision while preserving free-form input and adding no inference overhead. The provided content does not include the exact metric values, so the main tables to check are the open-source versus commercial model comparison, OCR/text accuracy, layout metric changes after Janus-Pro training, and degradation under multi-span prompts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the data construction figure and filtering rules to assess annotation noise. Then read the Layout-posting token format: coordinate discretization, span ordering, and how layout targets are appended after image tokens. In the experiments, focus on the metric definitions, difficulty-stratified benchmark, Janus-Pro main results, and ablations. For pretraining research, the useful parts are the data schema and the training objective rather than the poster-design application setting.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座 pretrain 主线，但数据接口设计很干净；若你做统一 AR 多模态，重点看 span token 这套最小侵入式训练改法。
recommendation.en: Not core foundation-model pretraining, but the data interface is clean; if you work on unified AR multimodal models, focus on the minimally invasive span-token training trick.

paper.title: Beyond Single Plots: A Benchmark for Question Answering on Multi-Charts
paper.abstract: Charts are widely used to present complex information. Deriving meaningful insights in real-world contexts often requires interpreting multiple related charts together. Research on understanding multi-chart images has not been extensively explored. We introduce PolyChartQA, a mid-scale dataset specifically designed for question answering over multi-chart images. PolyChartQA comprises 534 multi-chart images (with a total of 2,297 sub-charts) sourced from peer-reviewed computer science research pu

summary.core_problem: 解决现有 chart QA 主要停留在单图场景、无法衡量多图联合理解能力的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是 benchmark/data。对做原生多模态预训练的人有一点参考价值，因为它暴露了现有 MLLM 在跨图结构组合、真实人工问题上的明显短板，但不直接提出新的预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PolyChartQA，多图表问答数据集，包含来自计算机科学论文的 534 张 multi-chart 图像、共 2,297 个子图和 2,694 个 QA 对；并设计按问题类型、难度、问题来源和图表结构特征的细粒度评测，同时给出一个 prompting 改进。
summary.experiments: 评测了 9 个现有多模态语言模型。关键结果是：在人类撰写问题上，相比模型生成问题，准确率下降 27.4%；作者的 prompting 方法带来 5.39% 的 L-Accuracy 提升。数据规模中等，结论更适合作为能力缺口诊断，而非训练结论。
summary.authors_note: Iowa State University。工作是多图表理解 benchmark，适合做 VLM 评测集补充，但不是范式级多模态预训练研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of evaluation for question answering over multiple related charts, beyond the standard single-chart setting.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark/dataset. It has some value for native multimodal pretraining researchers because it exposes clear weaknesses of current MLLMs on cross-chart composition and human-authored questions, but it does not introduce a new pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces PolyChartQA, a multi-chart QA dataset with 534 multi-chart images from computer science papers, 2,297 sub-charts, and 2,694 QA pairs. The benchmark supports fine-grained analysis by question type, difficulty, source, and structural chart properties, and includes a prompting improvement.
summary_en.experiments: Nine state-of-the-art multimodal language models are evaluated. The key findings are a 27.4% accuracy drop on human-authored questions relative to model-generated ones, and a 5.39% L-Accuracy gain from the proposed prompting method. The dataset is mid-scale and more diagnostic than training-oriented.
summary_en.authors_note: Iowa State University. This is a benchmark for multi-chart understanding, useful as an additional VLM evaluation set but not a paradigm-level multimodal pretraining paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是训练论文，但可当 VLM 诊断集备查；只看数据构成和 human-vs-synthetic 的 27.4% gap，能提醒你别拿合成题高估模型。
recommendation.en: Not a training paper, but a useful VLM diagnostic benchmark; just read the dataset design and the 27.4% human-vs-synthetic gap to avoid overestimating models on synthetic QA.

paper.title: VG-CoT: Towards Trustworthy Visual Reasoning via Grounded Chain-of-Thought
paper.abstract: The advancement of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) requires precise local region-based reasoning that faithfully grounds the model's logic in actual visual evidence. However, existing datasets face limitations in scalability due to extensive manual annotation and lack of explicit alignment between multi-step reasoning and corresponding image regions, which constrains the evaluation of model trustworthiness. To address these challenges, we propose the Visual Grounding Chain-of-Thought (VG-Co

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个能够显式对齐多步推理与对应图像区域的数据集，以评估和提升大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在局部区域推理上的可信度？
summary.importance: 提出了 Visual Grounding Chain-of-Thought (VG-CoT) 数据集和一个全自动的构建 pipeline，解决了现有数据集在可扩展性和推理-区域对齐方面的局限性，并提供了一个新的 benchmark 来全面评估 LVLMs 的推理准确性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个全自动的三阶段 pipeline：1) 使用 SOTA 检测和 OCR 模型提取对象和文本级别的视觉证据；2) 使用 GPT-4o 生成逐步的 grounded reasoning；3) 通过 rationale-driven 的开放集检测过程细化 grounding。
summary.experiments: 引入了一个新的 benchmark，用于评估 LVLMs 的推理准确性。具体模型参数量、训练数据规模和 baseline 效果未在摘要中详述。

summary_en.core_problem: How to construct a dataset that explicitly aligns multi-step reasoning with corresponding image regions to evaluate and improve the trustworthiness of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) in local region-based reasoning?
summary_en.importance: Proposes the Visual Grounding Chain-of-Thought (VG-CoT) dataset and a fully automated construction pipeline, addressing the limitations of existing datasets in scalability and reasoning-region alignment, and introduces a new benchmark to comprehensively evaluate LVLM reasoning accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a fully automated three-stage pipeline: 1) extracts object- and text-level visual evidence using SOTA detection and OCR models; 2) generates step-by-step grounded reasoning with GPT-4o; 3) refines the grounding through a rationale-driven open-set detection process.
summary_en.experiments: Introduces a new benchmark to evaluate LVLM reasoning accuracy. Specific model parameters, training data scale, and baseline results are not detailed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 构建了一个多模态 CoT 数据集，将推理步骤与图像区域对齐，对 VLM 的精细化推理和可解释性有一定参考价值，但属于数据构建工作，作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Constructs a multimodal CoT dataset aligning reasoning steps with image regions, offering some reference value for fine-grained reasoning and interpretability of VLMs, but it's primarily a data construction effort; keep as literature reference.

paper.title: DiagramBank: A Large-scale Dataset of Diagram Design Exemplars with Paper Metadata for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Recent advances in autonomous ``AI scientist'' systems have demonstrated the ability to automatically write scientific manuscripts and codes with execution. However, producing a publication-grade scientific diagram (e.g., teaser figure) is still a major bottleneck in the ``end-to-end'' paper generation process. For example, a teaser figure acts as a strategic visual interface and serves a different purpose than derivative data plots. It demands conceptual synthesis and planning to translate comp

summary.core_problem: 为“论文级示意图/teaser图”生成提供可检索的高质量示例库与元数据，补齐AI scientist流水线中的图示环节。
summary.importance: 数据集贡献为主：大规模科学示意图+论文元数据，适合做多模态检索/检索增强生成；对VLM预训练的直接方法论贡献有限，但可作为图文对齐与结构化图形理解的数据源。
summary.technical_approach: DiagramBank：自动化从顶会论文中爬取/清洗示意图，配套论文元数据，面向多模态检索与exemplar-driven生成（更偏RAG式生成而非端到端扩散）。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出规模89,422张示意图；未给出检索/生成基线、评测协议与提升幅度，需看是否提供标准split与可复现实验。
summary.authors_note: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute（RPI）等

summary_en.core_problem: Provide a large retrievable corpus of publication-grade scientific schematic/teaser diagrams with metadata to support diagram generation in AI-scientist pipelines.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a dataset contribution: large-scale scientific diagrams + paper metadata for multimodal retrieval and RAG-style exemplar-driven generation; limited direct methodological novelty for VLM pretraining but potentially a useful alignment/understanding data source.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiagramBank: an automated curation pipeline to collect and clean schematic diagrams from top-tier scientific papers, paired with paper metadata, targeting multimodal retrieval and exemplar-driven generation.
summary_en.experiments: Reports 89,422 diagrams in the abstract; missing retrieval/generation baselines, evaluation protocol, and gains—check for standard splits and reproducibility.
summary_en.authors_note: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI) and others

recommendation.zh: 作为“高质量科学示意图语料”值得入库，但论文价值取决于标注/元数据质量与检索评测是否标准化；预训练研究员只需确认数据许可、噪声率和split设计。
recommendation.en: Worth noting as a corpus of publication-grade scientific schematics, but the value hinges on metadata quality and standardized retrieval eval; only verify licensing, noise rate, and split design.

paper.title: Revisiting Non-Verbatim Memorization in Large Language Models: The Role of Entity Surface Forms
paper.abstract: Understanding what kinds of factual knowledge large language models (LLMs) memorize is essential for evaluating their reliability and limitations. Entity-based QA is a common framework for analyzing non-verbatim memorization, but typical evaluations query each entity using a single canonical surface form, making it difficult to disentangle fact memorization from access through a particular name. We introduce RedirectQA, an entity-based QA dataset that uses Wikipedia redirect information to assoc

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型记没记住事实”这个老问题本身，而是更细的一层：同一个事实在参数里是否能被不同实体表述稳定访问。以往 entity-based QA 通常只用 canonical name 提问，于是“事实未记住”和“事实记住了但这个别名触发不出来”会混在一起。论文把 subject entity 的 surface form 当作受控变量，在固定 Wikidata 三元组与答案不变的前提下，只替换实体名称，专门测量 factual access 对表述形式的敏感性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三点。第一，它把 non-verbatim memorization 从单一实体频次问题，拆成了 entity-level memory 与 surface-level access 两层，这对解释知识记忆、长尾实体失败、以及 hallucination 的来源都更准确。第二，它说明 canonical-name 评测会系统性高估模型的事实可访问性，尤其当真实世界查询更常使用别名、缩写、拼写变体时。第三，它给出一个更贴近预训练机制的问题：模型到底是在记“实体-关系-答案”的抽象绑定，还是在记若干高频字符串模式；结果显示两者都不是极端成立，而是存在跨表述耦合但又不完全表述不变。这对数据去重、实体规范化、知识编辑、以及 retrieval 与 parametric memory 的接口设计都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，核心贡献是构建 RedirectQA。数据从 Wikidata factual triples 出发，把 subject entity 对齐到 Wikipedia article title 作为 canonical surface form，再利用 redirect pages 收集同一实体的其他表述。论文没有把所有 redirect 生硬纳入，而是做了较细的筛选与类别标注，区分 alternative names、abbreviations/initialisms、spelling variants、带或不带变音符号、标点差异、常见错误形式等，从而能按变体类型分析鲁棒性。评测设计上保持 relation 与 gold object 固定，只改 subject string，避免了不同问题模板或不同事实难度带来的混杂因素。分析层面，作者看了两类量：一类是 accuracy 本身，另一类是同一 canonical–redirect 对上的 prediction consistency。这样能区分“整体都不会”和“会但不稳定访问”。进一步，他们把频次拆成 entity aggregate frequency 与 individual surface frequency，分析两者与答对率的关系。如果只有 surface frequency 起作用，说明更像字符串级记忆；如果 entity frequency 还有独立贡献，说明不同表述之间存在共享的实体级表示或知识耦合。全文结论支持后者，但耦合并不强到足以实现完全表述不变。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 13 个 LLM。文中最直接的诊断信号是：在 Pythia-12B 上，对 redirect-augmented PopQA 的初步检查里，23.7% 的 canonical–redirect 问题对给出不一致预测，这已经说明单用 canonical name 会漏掉大量访问失败。系统评测后，作者发现这种不一致在多模型上普遍存在，而且强烈依赖表述类别。对轻微正字法变化，诸如拼写差异、变音符号、标点变化，模型相对稳；对词汇层面变化更大的别名、替代名称、缩写，稳定性明显更差。频次分析是全文更有信息量的一部分：surface-level frequency 与 accuracy 正相关并不意外，但把 entity-level aggregate frequency 纳入后，后者通常仍有额外解释力，说明模型并非把每个表述完全独立记忆。换句话说，某个低频别名有时能借助高频 canonical form 获得一定可访问性，但这种迁移并不充分，因此仍会出现同事实跨表述失配。论文的重点不在追求单一 benchmark 分数，而在揭示误差结构；从这个角度看，类别分层结果和频次分解比总准确率更值得看。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction，把问题设定和 canonical-name 评测的盲点吃透；再看 RedirectQA 构建部分，重点关注 redirect 的筛选规则、类别定义，以及哪些 redirect 被排除，因为这直接决定数据是否真在测“同一实体的不同表述”。随后看结果部分里两张内容：一是不同 surface categories 下的 accuracy / consistency 对比，二是 entity frequency 与 surface frequency 的分解分析。这两部分基本构成全文的主要信息。若时间有限，优先读问题定义、数据构建原则、类别分层结果和频次回归/相关性分析，预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主要结论。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是这种表述敏感性究竟来自 tokenizer 切分、预训练共现统计，还是实体链接能力不足；二是如果把 retrieval、entity normalization 或 contrastive alias training 接进预训练，会不会显著改善这类失败。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates a narrower question than generic factual memorization: can an LLM access the same memorized fact reliably through different surface forms of the same entity? Standard entity-centric QA usually probes one canonical name per entity, which conflates two failure modes: the fact is not stored at all, or the fact is stored but not reachable through a particular alias. RedirectQA turns the entity surface form into a controlled variable while keeping the underlying Wikidata triple and gold answer fixed.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is in the decomposition it forces. Factual recall is not just about entity popularity or corpus frequency; it also depends on how knowledge is indexed by names. That matters for interpreting parametric memory, long-tail failures, and hallucinations. It also shows that canonical-name evaluations can overestimate factual accessibility, because real queries often use aliases, abbreviations, or noisy forms. More importantly, the results argue against two simplistic views: knowledge is neither fully tied to individual strings nor fully surface-invariant at the entity level. There is partial cross-surface coupling. That has implications for tokenizer design, entity normalization in data pipelines, deduplication, knowledge editing, and the interface between retrieval and parametric memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main technical contribution is the RedirectQA dataset. Starting from Wikidata factual triples, the authors map each subject entity to a Wikipedia article title as the canonical surface form, then use Wikipedia redirects to collect alternative mentions of the same entity. A useful detail is that redirects are not treated as uniformly valid aliases; the dataset construction includes filtering and category annotations, separating alternative names, abbreviations/initialisms, spelling variants, diacritic changes, punctuation variants, and common erroneous forms. The evaluation protocol holds the relation and gold object fixed and changes only the subject string, which removes confounds from template choice or fact difficulty. The analysis uses both answer accuracy and prediction consistency across canonical–redirect pairs, allowing the paper to distinguish “the model does not know the fact” from “the model knows it but accesses it unreliably.” A second key analysis decomposes frequency into entity-level aggregate frequency and surface-level frequency. If only surface frequency mattered, the phenomenon would look mostly string-local. If entity frequency still explained performance after controlling for surface frequency, that would indicate shared entity-level representations or cross-surface transfer. The paper finds the latter, but only partially.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 13 LLMs. A strong early diagnostic comes from Pythia-12B on a redirect-augmented PopQA setup: 23.7% of canonical–redirect question pairs produce inconsistent predictions. That already shows how much canonical-only evaluation can miss. In the full RedirectQA experiments, inconsistency remains common across models and depends strongly on the type of surface variation. Models are relatively robust to small orthographic changes such as spelling, diacritics, and punctuation, but much less stable under larger lexical shifts such as aliases, alternative names, and abbreviations. The frequency analysis is the most informative part of the paper. Surface-form frequency correlates with accuracy, as expected, but entity-level aggregate frequency often retains explanatory power beyond the specific surface frequency. This suggests that factual access is not learned independently for each alias. A low-frequency alias can sometimes benefit from a high-frequency canonical form, yet the transfer is incomplete, which is why the same fact can still fail under a different name. The paper is less about a single benchmark score and more about the structure of errors; the category-wise consistency results and the frequency decomposition are the main takeaways.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction to understand the exact failure mode the paper is targeting and why canonical-name probing is insufficient. Then read the dataset construction section carefully, especially the redirect filtering rules and category definitions; that is where the validity of the setup lives. After that, focus on two result blocks: category-wise accuracy/consistency comparisons, and the decomposition of entity frequency versus surface frequency. Those sections contain most of the paper’s signal. For a quick pass, 20–30 minutes is enough if you read the problem setup, dataset design principles, category-level findings, and the frequency analysis. The deeper questions worth carrying forward are whether the sensitivity comes mainly from tokenization, pretraining co-occurrence statistics, or weak entity linking, and whether alias-aware pretraining or retrieval-assisted normalization would reduce the gap.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改方法，但会改你看 memorization 的尺子；只看数据构造和按 surface form 分桶的结果，就足够指导内部知识评测重做一版。
recommendation.en: It does not change modeling, but it should change how you measure memorization; read the dataset design and the surface-form breakdown, then redo your internal knowledge evals.

paper.title: If you're waiting for a sign... that might not be it! Mitigating Trust Boundary Confusion from Visual Injections on Vision-Language Agentic Systems
paper.abstract: Recent advances in embodied Vision-Language Agentic Systems (VLAS), powered by large vision-language models (LVLMs), enable AI systems to perceive and reason over real-world scenes. Within this context, environmental signals such as traffic lights are essential in-band signals that can and should influence agent behavior. However, similar signals could also be crafted to operate as misleading visual injections, overriding user intent and posing security risks. This duality creates a fundamental

summary.core_problem: VLM智能体在真实场景中需要遵循“环境内嵌信号”（如交通灯），但同类视觉信号也可被攻击者伪造为注入提示，导致智能体越权偏离用户意图（trust boundary confusion）。
summary.importance: 偏安全评测与问题定义：提出双意图数据集与评测框架，系统量化LVLM agent在“遵循合法环境信号 vs 抵抗恶意视觉注入”之间的失衡；对多模态对齐/训练信号设计有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 构建dual-intent dataset与评测：同一场景同时存在用户意图与环境信号意图，环境信号既可能是应遵循的in-band指令，也可能是恶意注入；评测7个LVLM agent在多种具身设置下对结构化/非结构化视觉注入的鲁棒性与服从性权衡。
summary.experiments: 摘要披露评测对象为7个LVLM-based agents，覆盖多个具身设置与两类攻击（structure-based与另一类注入）；未给出具体模型名单、指标与数值结果。
summary.authors_note: University of New South Wales；合作者含Macquarie University。

summary_en.core_problem: VLM agents must follow legitimate in-band environmental signals (e.g., traffic lights), yet similar visual cues can be crafted as prompt injections that override user intent—creating trust boundary confusion.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a security problem formulation and evaluation contribution: a dual-intent dataset/framework to quantify the trade-off between obeying useful environmental cues and resisting malicious visual injections, with indirect implications for multimodal alignment/training signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: They build a dual-intent dataset and evaluation where user intent conflicts with environment-signal intent; the same channel can carry legitimate cues or malicious injections. They evaluate 7 LVLM agents across embodied settings under structure-based and other injection types.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions 7 LVLM-based agents and multiple embodied settings/attack types, but does not provide model names, metrics, or numeric results.
summary_en.authors_note: University of New South Wales; collaborator from Macquarie University.

recommendation.zh: 作为“视觉注入=环境信号同通道”的问题定义值得记住；读数据集设定与失败模式即可，防御结论在无数值细节前当弱信号。

paper.title: SWE-chat: Coding Agent Interactions From Real Users in the Wild
paper.abstract: AI coding agents are being adopted at scale, yet we lack empirical evidence on how people actually use them and how much of their output is useful in practice. We present SWE-chat, the first large-scale dataset of real coding agent sessions collected from open-source developers in the wild. The dataset currently contains 6,000 sessions, comprising more than 63,000 user prompts and 355,000 agent tool calls. SWE-chat is a living dataset; our collection pipeline automatically and continually discov

summary.core_problem: 现有AI编码Agent研究多依赖人工构建的基准数据集，缺乏真实场景下人类与编码Agent交互的实证数据，无法获知实际使用模式、真实失败模式以及Agent输出的实际有效率。
summary.importance: 公开首个大规模真实场景编码Agent交互数据集，可用于优化编码Agent训练数据、交互设计、基准构建，为编码Agent后训练、人机协作范式设计提供实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 构建SWE-chat数据集，从公开GitHub仓库的Entire.io CLI日志中自动收集真实开发者与编码Agent的完整交互轨迹，包含用户prompt、Agent工具调用、代码diff、行级代码作者归因等多维度数据。
summary.experiments: 数据集当前包含6000个会话、6.3万条用户prompt、35.5万次Agent工具调用，覆盖200多个仓库。实证分析得到多组结论：1）最常见用户意图为理解现有代码，Agent三分之一的工具调用为执行bash命令而非编辑文件；2）使用模式呈双峰分布，41%的会话中Agent生成几乎所有提交代码（vibe coding），其余会话中Agent生成代码占比极低；3）仅不到一半的Agent生成代码最终被用户提交；4）vibe coding模式下每提交一行代码消耗3倍token和成本，引入的安全漏洞为人类自写代码的9倍、人机协作代码的5倍；5）99.9分位的单次交互时长超过100分钟，Agent极少主动询问用户澄清，5%的轮次用户主动中断Agent，39%的轮次用户反驳Agent输出。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第2章数据集构建逻辑、第3-4章实证分析结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI coding agent research mostly relies on manually curated benchmark datasets, lacking empirical data of human-coding agent interaction in real scenarios, which makes it impossible to obtain actual usage patterns, real failure modes, and actual effectiveness of agent outputs.
summary_en.importance: This work releases the first large-scale real-scene coding agent interaction dataset, which can be used to optimize coding agent training data, interaction design, benchmark construction, and provides empirical basis for coding agent post-training and human-agent collaboration paradigm design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The SWE-chat dataset is constructed by automatically collecting complete interaction traces between real developers and coding agents from Entire.io CLI logs of public GitHub repositories, including multi-dimensional data such as user prompts, agent tool calls, code diffs, and line-level code authorship attribution.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset currently contains 6000 sessions, 63,000 user prompts, 355,000 agent tool calls, covering more than 200 repositories. Empirical analysis draws multiple conclusions: 1) The most common user intent is to understand existing code, and one third of agent tool calls are executing bash commands instead of editing files; 2) Usage patterns show bimodal distribution: 41% of sessions have agents generating almost all committed code (vibe coding), while agents contribute very little code in the rest sessions; 3) Less than half of agent-generated code is finally committed by users; 4) In vibe coding mode, each committed line of code consumes 3x tokens and cost, and introduces 9x more security vulnerabilities than human-written code, 5x more than human-agent co-authored code; 5) The 99.9th percentile of single interaction duration exceeds 100 minutes, agents rarely actively ask users for clarification, users actively interrupt agents in 5% of turns, and users push back against agent outputs in 39% of turns.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the dataset construction logic in Chapter 2, empirical analysis results in Chapter 3 and Chapter 4, estimated reading time 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但数据分布很值钱：44% 代码保留率这类数字会直接影响你怎么定义 agent 训练目标与离线评测，先看 failure mode 统计。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but the distributional evidence is valuable: numbers like 44% code survival should change how you define agent training targets and offline evaluation; start with the failure-mode analysis.

paper.title: GTASA: Ground Truth Annotations for Spatiotemporal Analysis, Evaluation and Training of Video Models

summary.core_problem: 如何为视频生成与视频理解提供“可验证的物理合理性与语义忠实性”的地面真值（ground truth）标注，从而能系统评测/诊断视频模型的时空推理能力，并提供可扩展训练数据。
summary.importance: 真实视频数据存在规模与标注丰富度的长期矛盾：大规模数据标注粗糙，小规模数据标注昂贵且噪声大。与此同时，神经视频生成器常出现物体凭空出现/消失、交互不符合物理等问题，但缺乏可对齐的时空真值使得评估困难。若能利用 3D 游戏引擎的显式世界状态（实体身份、几何、遮挡、事件时间线），就能以零边际标注成本生成带完美时空标注的视频，用于评测、探针分析与训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GTASA 数据集与生成系统 GEST-Engine。核心是以 Graphs of Events in Space and Time (GEST) 作为“可执行规范”：图中编码演员/对象/动作及其时序与空间约束；系统在 3D 引擎中确定性执行该规范并渲染 RGB 视频，同时同步导出两类关键真值：(1) 每帧的实体间空间关系图（pairwise spatial relation graphs）；(2) 事件级到帧级的精确时间映射（event-to-frame temporal mappings）。为支持多演员并发与复杂叙事编排，GEST-Engine 引入 Allen 时序关系、基于 Floyd–Warshall 的约束满足以协调多 actor 事件，并支持程序化生成（可参数化动作数量与并发演员数）与多模态产物收集。作者强调其目标不是追求照片级真实感，而是提供神经生成器无法直接给出的结构化真值与可控性。
summary.experiments: 围绕三个问题验证：Q1 人类评测对比 GEST-Engine 与开源/闭源神经视频生成器，在物理有效性与语义对齐上更优（文中 Table 3）。Q2 将合成数据用于视频字幕模型微调，尽管存在域差异仍带来收益（Tables 5/6）。Q3 用 GTASA 支持的 11 个时空推理任务对四个冻结视频编码器做 probing，发现自监督视频编码器在编码时空结构上显著优于 VLM 编码器（Table 7）。数据规模方面：938 个多演员视频、28.2K 动作片段、1.45M 帧上 8.92 亿对空间关系、29.6K 事件-帧映射，并开源生成管线以扩展。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim 泛读】优先看：Introduction（为何需要引擎真值与 GEST 表示）、System Overview/Method（GEST-Engine 如何把事件图变成视频+标注）、Experiments 三个问题的主表（Table 3/5/6/7）与结论。
【must_read 精读】重点精读：1) GEST 表示与约束系统（Allen 关系如何表达并发/先后/重叠；Floyd–Warshall 约束满足如何保证可执行性）；2) 标注定义（空间关系图包含哪些关系、如何从 3D 状态投影/计算；事件到帧映射如何处理持续事件与边界）；3) probing 任务设计（11 个任务分别测什么时空能力、输入输出与评估指标）；4) 人类评测协议（物理有效性/语义对齐的定义、对比基线与统计显著性）。
【创新点抓手】(a) 用“可执行事件图”统一生成与标注；(b) 多演员并发叙事 + 完美时空真值；(c) 用该真值系统性诊断视频编码器到底学到了什么时空结构。
summary.authors_note: 作者主张：与其仅用像素级视频去逼近世界，不如利用游戏引擎的显式世界模型来提供可控、可扩展、带完美真值的基准与训练资源。GTASA/ GEST-Engine 的价值在于把‘时空结构是否被模型编码’变成可精确检验的问题，并揭示不同视频编码器家族在时空结构表征上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: How to obtain reliable ground-truth annotations for physical plausibility and semantic faithfulness in videos—enabling systematic evaluation, probing, and training of video models on spatiotemporal reasoning, especially in complex multi-actor scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Real-world video datasets face a persistent tradeoff: large scale but weak/coarse labels vs rich annotations that are small, noisy, and expensive. Neural video generators still exhibit implausible physics and inconsistent object permanence, yet evaluation is hard without aligned spatiotemporal ground truth. A 3D game engine maintains explicit world state (entities, geometry, occlusion, event timelines), making it possible to generate videos with perfect synchronized annotations at near-zero marginal labeling cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduce GTASA and its generator, GEST-Engine. The key idea is to use Graphs of Events in Space and Time (GEST) as an executable specification encoding actors, objects, actions, and their temporal/spatial constraints. The engine deterministically executes the GEST program in a 3D environment, renders RGB video, and exports synchronized ground truth: (1) per-frame pairwise spatial relation graphs; (2) exact event-to-frame temporal mappings. To support multi-actor orchestration and concurrent narratives, GEST-Engine uses Allen temporal relations and a Floyd–Warshall-based constraint satisfaction procedure, plus procedural graph generation with a parametric number of actions and concurrent actors. The goal is not photorealism but controllability and structured annotations that neural generators cannot provide.
summary_en.experiments: They validate three questions: Q1 human studies comparing GEST-Engine to open/closed neural video generators show higher physical validity and semantic alignment (Table 3). Q2 adding synthetic GEST data improves video captioning fine-tuning despite domain gap (Tables 5/6). Q3 GTASA enables probing four frozen video encoders on 11 spatiotemporal reasoning tasks; self-supervised video encoders encode spatiotemporal structure significantly better than VLM encoders (Table 7). Dataset stats: 938 multi-actor videos, 28.2K action clips, 892M pairwise spatial relations over 1.45M frames, and 29.6K event-to-frame mappings; the pipeline is released to scale further.
summary_en.reading_guide:
[Skim] Read: Introduction (why engine ground truth + why GEST), Method/System overview (how GEST-Engine produces video + annotations), and the main experiment tables (Table 3, 5, 6, 7).
[Must-read] Focus on: (1) the GEST formalism and orchestration (how Allen relations express overlap/precedence/concurrency; how Floyd–Warshall constraint satisfaction ensures executability); (2) annotation definitions (what spatial relations are included and how computed from 3D state; how event-to-frame mappings handle durations/boundaries); (3) the 11 probing tasks (what capability each isolates, I/O, metrics); (4) the human evaluation protocol (definitions of physical validity/semantic alignment, baselines, significance).
[Innovation hooks] (a) executable event graphs unify generation and perfect labeling; (b) multi-actor concurrent narratives with dense spatiotemporal ground truth; (c) using this ground truth to diagnose what spatiotemporal structure video encoders actually represent.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper argues for leveraging explicit world models in game engines to create controllable, scalable datasets with perfect spatiotemporal ground truth. GTASA/ GEST-Engine turns ‘does a model encode spatiotemporal structure?’ into a precisely testable question and provides evidence that encoder families differ substantially in the spatiotemporal structure they capture.

recommendation.zh: 当作“可控视频世界状态”数据源备查即可：只看标注覆盖表和评测协议，判断能否直接拿来做时空一致性探针。
recommendation.en: Useful mainly as a controllable world-state data source: skim the annotation coverage table and eval protocol to see if it plugs into your temporal-consistency probes.

paper.title: Why Don't You Know? Evaluating the Impact of Uncertainty Sources on Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM 不确定性量化（UQ）方法通常输出单一置信度分数，但自然语言任务的不确定性来源多样（知识缺口、输出多解/可变性、输入歧义等）。核心问题是：不同不确定性来源会如何影响各类 UQ 方法的行为与有效性？现有评测缺乏对来源的可控隔离，导致比较不公平。
summary.importance: 在医疗、法律、教育等高风险场景，系统需要根据“不确定性来源”采取不同动作：知识不足→检索/拒答；多解可变→给多个答案或解释多样性；输入歧义→追问澄清。若 UQ 分数无法区分来源，可能触发错误策略（例如把“多解”当成“不会”而拒答），直接影响安全性与用户体验。因此需要来源可控的数据与系统性评测来揭示方法盲点。
summary.technical_approach:
论文的关键技术贡献是构建一个“按不确定性来源成组控制”的评测数据集，并在该数据集上系统评估多类 UQ 方法。
- 不确定性来源最小集合：
(1) 知识不确定性（问题明确且单一正确，但模型可能不知道）；
(2) 输出可变性/多正确答案（问题明确但存在多个语义上不同的正确回答，概率质量分散导致采样输出不一致）；
(3) 输入歧义（问题欠指明，需澄清才能确定所问）。
- 数据集设计：以 triplets 组织问题，每个三元组在长度、格式、领域等方面尽量可比，仅改变不确定性来源，从而控制混杂因素，实现对 UQ 方法的公平对比；并进行人工验证。
- 评测范围：覆盖多种 UQ 家族（如基于 token 概率、基于一致性/自一致、verbalized 等）与多个模型，分析不同来源下的系统性失效模式与家族弱点。
summary.experiments: 在三类不确定性场景下，对多种 UQ 方法与三种模型进行对比评测，并做失败案例分析。论文强调的经验现象包括：一致性类方法可能把“多正确答案导致的输出不一致”误判为高不确定（尽管模型其实可以自信给出任一正确答案）；输入歧义会让“是否知道答案”的判定变得更困难，且更应触发澄清而非简单拒答；不同方法家族对不同来源呈现特定脆弱性。数据集与分析用于揭示这些差异并指导方法选择/系统策略。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点章节：Introduction（为何“来源”重要以及对应的系统动作；Figure 1 的决策映射）；Dataset Creation（triplet 设计如何隔离混杂因素；三类来源的操作化定义与构造流程；人工验证标准）；实验与失败案例分析（按来源分桶的对比结果，逐类总结哪些方法在何种来源下失效以及原因）。
- 重点图表/内容：Figure 1（不确定性来源→系统响应）；数据集统计与示例 triplets（理解“只变来源不变其他”的控制思想）；按来源拆分的性能表/校准曲线/相关性分析（如果文中提供）。
- 创新点核对：①来源可控的 triplet 数据集；②跨方法家族、跨模型的系统评测；③面向部署决策的失败模式归因。

skim（泛读）：
- 先读 Introduction + 贡献点列表（理解三类来源与动机）+ Dataset Creation 的三类定义段落（知道每类在问答里长什么样）+ 实验结论/讨论（抓住“哪些 UQ 方法在多解/歧义下会误报”的主结论）。
summary.authors_note: 作者主张 UQ 不应只追求单一“正确性置信度”，而应关注不确定性来源，因为来源决定系统应对策略；并通过 triplet 控制数据集证明：很多现有 UQ 信号在不同来源下含义会发生偏移，导致方法比较与部署决策都可能被误导。

summary_en.core_problem: Most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods output a single confidence score, but uncertainty in language tasks comes from distinct sources (knowledge gaps, output variability with multiple valid answers, and input ambiguity). The paper asks: how do these sources affect the behavior and effectiveness of existing UQ methods, and how can we evaluate this fairly under controlled conditions?
summary_en.importance: In high-stakes deployments, the right system action depends on the uncertainty source: lack of knowledge → retrieve/abstain; multiple valid answers → present alternatives; ambiguous input → ask for clarification. If a UQ score conflates sources, systems may take harmful actions (e.g., abstain when the question simply has many correct answers). A source-controlled benchmark is necessary to diagnose method weaknesses and guide safe decision policies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main technical contribution is a controlled evaluation dataset and protocol that isolates uncertainty sources.
- Minimal, operational source set:
(1) knowledge uncertainty (well-specified, single correct answer, model may not know);
(2) output variability / multiple correct answers (well-specified but many semantically distinct valid answers; probability mass spreads, sampled outputs disagree);
(3) input ambiguity (underspecified question requiring clarification).
- Dataset design: questions are organized into triplets; within each triplet, questions are made comparable in length/format/domain while differing primarily in uncertainty source, reducing confounds and enabling fair method comparison; human validation is performed.
- Evaluation: benchmark a broad set of UQ method families (token-probability-based, consistency-based, verbalized, etc.) across multiple models, and analyze source-specific failure modes.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates many UQ methods on the triplet dataset across three models, reporting performance by uncertainty source and providing failure-case analyses. Highlighted findings include: consistency-based methods can over-report uncertainty for the “multiple valid answers” scenario (treating semantic disagreement as ignorance); ambiguity makes it hard to interpret confidence as knowledge and should trigger clarification rather than abstention; different UQ families exhibit characteristic vulnerabilities depending on the source.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep read):
- Key sections: Introduction (why sources matter; the source→system-action mapping, esp. Figure 1); Dataset Creation (how triplets control confounds; operational definitions and construction; human validation); Experiments + failure analysis (results stratified by source; method-family weaknesses and causal explanations).
- Key figures/tables: Figure 1 (uncertainty source to downstream action); dataset examples/statistics showing triplet control; per-source performance/calibration plots if provided.
- Innovation checklist: (i) source-controlled triplet dataset; (ii) systematic cross-family, cross-model UQ evaluation; (iii) deployment-oriented failure attribution.

skim (quick read):
- Read Introduction + contributions, the three source definitions in Dataset Creation, and the main results/discussion to capture the headline: many UQ signals change meaning across sources, especially for multi-answer and ambiguous inputs.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue UQ should be source-aware because the source determines the appropriate system response. Their controlled triplet benchmark shows that many existing UQ methods conflate sources, making both method comparisons and deployment decisions potentially misleading.

recommendation.zh: 把UQ拆成可控来源后才看得出方法在“多解/歧义”上乱报置信度；只读实验设计与分解结果表即可校准你对UQ分数的信任边界。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the controlled source-factorization: it exposes when UQ scores conflate ambiguity/variability with ignorance; read the setup + main decomposition table to recalibrate how much you trust a single confidence number.

paper.title: UniToolCall: Unifying Tool-Use Representation, Data, and Evaluation for LLM Agents

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM Agent 的工具学习（tool-use）研究在“表示—数据—评测”三条链路上高度碎片化：不同数据集/框架的 tool-call schema 不兼容导致难以联合训练；训练数据对工具交互“结构分布”（尤其串行/并行、单跳/多跳、单轮/多轮）建模不足；评测基准协议与脚本不统一造成结果不可比、难复现。
summary.importance: 工具调用是 Agent 从“生成文本”走向“可执行行动”的核心能力。碎片化会直接限制：1）跨数据源规模化训练；2）对规划与执行结构的系统性分析与可控提升；3）在真实部署中对鲁棒性（干扰工具、多轮依赖、并行调用）的可靠评估。UniToolCall 试图把工具学习做成“可标准化的工程与科研底座”，降低数据/评测的不可比成本。
summary.technical_approach:
UniToolCall 提出统一框架，核心是把全流程标准化到同一交互表示与评测协议上。
1）统一表示：将不同来源的工具交互统一到 Query–Action–Observation–Answer（QAOA）格式，规范 tool call、参数、观测与最终回答的组织方式，并配套统一匹配规则。
2）工具池构建：聚合学术基准、MCP servers、构造数据集等来源，经过多阶段过滤，得到 22K+ 工具；全部标准化为统一 JSON Schema。并按“功能类别（6 类）×应用领域（13 域）”做语义组织，便于均衡采样与覆盖。
3）混合训练语料：构建 390K+ 训练实例，来源包括（a）10 个公开工具数据集的标准化整合；（b）结构可控的合成交互轨迹。合成部分显式控制单跳/多跳、单轮/多轮，并重点覆盖串行与并行两类执行结构。
4）结构感知合成机制：提出 Anchor Linkage 机制在多轮对话中强制跨轮依赖（例如后续调用必须引用前轮产物/变量/中间结论），避免“轮间松耦合”的伪多轮数据；同时通过结构装配（structural assembly）让轨迹分布可控，从而能分析不同结构对能力的影响。
5）统一评测：把异构 benchmark 转为 QAOA，并提供标准化评测协议与多粒度指标（函数调用级、轮级、对话级），支持在不同任务结构下公平比较。
summary.experiments: 论文报告在统一评测设置下，对轻量模型 Qwen3-8B 进行框架内微调可取得强结果：在 distractor-heavy 的 Hybrid-20 设置下，单轮 Strict Precision 达到 93.0%，并宣称超过 GPT/Gemini/Claude 等商用模型。实验重点体现：统一表示+结构可控数据对“抗干扰工具选择”“多步/多轮执行一致性”“严格匹配的函数调用正确率”等指标的提升，并通过细粒度指标支持对串行/并行结构差异的诊断。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim（泛读）】
- 读 Introduction：抓住三大碎片化痛点（表示不一致/结构欠建模/评测不匹配）与 UniToolCall 的三件套（工具池、混合数据、统一评测）。
- 读 UniToolCall 框架总览段 + Figure 2：理解 QAOA 在流水线中的位置（数据整合、合成、评测的共同接口）。
- 快看工具池来源与分类（提到 Figure 7、6×13 taxonomy）：理解为何需要语义组织来做均衡采样。
- 快看实验主结论：Hybrid-20、Strict Precision 等关键指标与“超过商用模型”的对比口径。

【must_read（精读）】
- 精读 QAOA 表示与匹配规则：这是能否“跨数据集联合训练/统一评测”的关键，建议对照附录中的单跳样例（文中提示 Appendix C.2）。
- 精读合成数据管线：重点看如何显式控制（单/多跳、单/多轮、串行/并行）以及 structural assembly 的实现细节；关注 Anchor Linkage 如何把跨轮变量/实体/中间结果绑定到后续调用。
- 精读统一 benchmark 与指标：函数调用级/轮级/对话级的定义、Strict vs 非 Strict 的判定、以及 distractor-heavy（Hybrid-20）如何构造与为何更贴近真实。
- 精读消融/结构分析（若正文或附录提供）：建议按“仅公共数据→+合成→+结构控制→+Anchor Linkage→+统一评测脚本”顺序验证每个组件的边际贡献。
- 图表优先级：Figure 2（框架总览）、Figure 7（工具池来源与过滤/标准化流程）、以及任何展示串行/并行轨迹分布与性能差异的图表。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：工具学习的瓶颈不只在模型或提示，而在数据与评测的“结构化与标准化”。通过统一表示（QAOA）把异构数据与评测对齐，再用结构可控的合成轨迹补齐真实数据难覆盖的交互结构分布，最终让训练可规模化、评测可复现、分析可诊断。

summary_en.core_problem: Tool-use learning for LLM agents is fragmented across the full pipeline: (1) incompatible tool-call schemas prevent joint training across datasets; (2) training data under-models the structural distribution of tool trajectories (notably serial vs. parallel execution, and single-/multi-hop, single-/multi-turn patterns); (3) evaluation benchmarks use mismatched protocols and scripts, making results hard to compare and reproduce.
summary_en.importance: Tool calling is the key capability that turns LLMs from text generators into executable agents. Fragmentation directly limits scalable multi-source training, systematic improvement of planning/execution structures, and reliable evaluation under realistic settings (distractor tools, multi-turn dependencies, parallel calls). UniToolCall aims to provide a standardized research/engineering substrate for tool learning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
UniToolCall unifies representation, data, and evaluation.
1) Unified representation: converts heterogeneous interactions into a shared Query–Action–Observation–Answer (QAOA) format, standardizing tool calls, arguments, observations, and final answers, together with unified matching rules.
2) Tool pool: aggregates tools from academic benchmarks, MCP servers, and constructed datasets; applies multi-stage filtering to obtain 22K+ tools; standardizes all tools into a unified JSON Schema; organizes tools by a 6 (functional categories) × 13 (application domains) taxonomy for balanced sampling.
3) Hybrid training corpus: builds 390K+ instances by integrating 10 standardized public tool-use datasets plus structurally controlled synthetic trajectories.
4) Structure-aware synthesis: explicitly models single-/multi-hop, single-/multi-turn, and crucially serial vs. parallel execution patterns; introduces an Anchor Linkage mechanism to enforce cross-turn dependencies so later turns must reference earlier intermediate results/variables.
5) Unified evaluation: converts benchmarks into QAOA and provides a standardized evaluation protocol with multi-granularity metrics (function-call, turn, conversation) for fair comparisons across task structures.
summary_en.experiments: Under the unified protocol, fine-tuning a lightweight Qwen3-8B within UniToolCall yields strong results. In the distractor-heavy Hybrid-20 setting, it reports 93.0% single-turn Strict Precision, claimed to outperform leading commercial models (GPT/Gemini/Claude). The evaluation emphasizes strict function-call correctness, robustness to distractor tools, and consistency across multi-step/multi-turn structures enabled by the unified metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide:
【skim】
- Read Introduction for the three fragmentation axes and the high-level solution.
- Read the framework overview + Figure 2 to understand how QAOA serves as the common interface for integration, synthesis, and evaluation.
- Skim the tool pool construction and taxonomy (incl. Figure 7) to see how coverage and balanced sampling are achieved.
- Skim the headline results (Hybrid-20, Strict Precision) and the comparison protocol.

【must_read】
- Deep-read QAOA and the matching rules; cross-check with the single-hop example referenced in Appendix C.2.
- Deep-read the synthetic pipeline: how structural controls are implemented for hop/turn and serial/parallel patterns; how structural assembly works; and how Anchor Linkage enforces real cross-turn dependency.
- Deep-read the unified benchmark and metrics: definitions at function/turn/conversation levels, strict vs non-strict criteria, and how Hybrid-20 distractors are constructed.
- Prioritize figures: Figure 2 (end-to-end framework), Figure 7 (tool pool sources/filtering/standardization), and any plots analyzing performance vs trajectory structure (serial vs parallel, hop/turn).
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s thesis is that progress in tool learning is bottlenecked by standardization and structural coverage, not only by model architecture or prompting. By unifying all data and evaluation under QAOA and adding structure-controlled synthetic trajectories (with enforced cross-turn dependencies), UniToolCall enables scalable training, reproducible evaluation, and diagnosable improvements.

recommendation.zh: 当标准化提案快速扫：只看 schema 设计与评测脚本即可；科研新 insight 有限，但若你在做多源 tool 数据混训，这套规范能立刻降摩擦。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a standardization proposal: read the schema and eval harness only; limited new insight, but if you’re mixing multi-source tool data, adopting the spec can immediately cut integration friction.

paper.title: CT-1: Vision-Language-Camera Models Transfer Spatial Reasoning Knowledge to Camera-Controllable Video Generation

summary.core_problem: 在视频生成中实现可控且物理合理的相机运动：解决文本控制不精确与手工轨迹参数成本高的问题。
summary.importance: 系统/方法创新：提出“Vision-Language-Camera”中间模型将空间推理/相机轨迹估计显式化，再注入视频扩散模型实现可控生成；并配套数据构建（CT-200），对视频生成可控性与可用性具有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CT-1（Camera Transformer 1）：基于视觉-语言模块与Diffusion Transformer，学习从输入（文本/视觉线索）到相机轨迹分布的映射；引入频域Wavelet正则损失以学习复杂轨迹；将预测轨迹作为条件输入集成到视频扩散模型中实现空间感知的相机控制；同时设计数据清洗/构建管线并发布CT-200数据集。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据规模、与哪些视频生成/相机控制baseline对比、定量指标与提升幅度；仅声明能更好对齐用户意图并实现物理合理相机运动。需查全文确认：CT-200规模、轨迹误差指标、生成质量/一致性指标、以及对比（如文本到视频模型+控制方法）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to achieve controllable and physically plausible camera motion in video generation without relying on imprecise text-only control or costly hand-specified camera trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a vision–language–camera intermediate modeling stage that explicitly learns spatial reasoning and camera-trajectory estimation and then conditions a video diffusion model on the predicted trajectory; paired with a curated dataset (CT-200), this directly improves usability and controllability for camera-aware video synthesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CT-1 (Camera Transformer): a model combining vision–language components with a diffusion transformer to map inputs (text and/or visual cues) to a distribution over camera trajectories; employs a frequency-domain wavelet regularization loss to learn complex motions; integrates the predicted trajectory as a conditioning signal for a video diffusion generator; and provides a data cleaning/construction pipeline releasing the CT-200 dataset.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states improved alignment to user intent and more physically reasonable camera motion, but does not specify model/data scale, trajectory-error metrics, generation-quality metrics, or the baselines used for comparison.

recommendation.zh: 把相机轨迹显式成中间表征再蒸到扩散模型，工程上很实用但对预训练启发有限；看CT-200数据定义和可控性对比图即可。
recommendation.en: Explicitly modeling camera motion as an intermediate representation then injecting it into diffusion is practically useful but not very pretraining-relevant; just read the CT-200 spec and controllability comparisons.
